Figure skating: Chiba wins Cup of China to extend Japan women's GP streak
Figure skating: Chiba wins Cup of China to extend Japan women's GP streak
- Nov 07, 2026 - 23:07 All,Sports
Japan's Mone Chiba performs her free skate at the Cup of China in Shenzhen, China, on Nov. 7, 2026. (Kyodo)
Japan's Mone Chiba reacts after her free skate at the Cup of China in Shenzhen, China, on Nov. 7, 2026. (Kyodo)
Japan's Mone Chiba poses for a photo after winning the Cup of China in Shenzhen, China, on Nov. 7, 2026. (Kyodo)
Japan's Yuna Nagaoka (top) and Sumitada Moriguchi perform their pairs' free skate at the Cup of China in Shenzhen, China, on Nov. 7, 2026. (Kyodo)
Japan's Yuna Nagaoka (L) and Sumitada Moriguchi pose for a photo after winning bronze at the Cup of China in Shenzhen, China, on Nov. 7, 2026. (Kyodo)
SHENZHEN, China - Japan's Mone Chiba won the Cup of China on Saturday to extend Japanese women's winning streak to three events at the start of the Grand Prix Series season.
Top after Friday's short program, last season's world championships runner-up Chiba scored 148.40 points in the free skate for a total of 224.48 in Shenzhen, claiming the third Grand Prix victory of her career.
The 21-year-old joined fellow Japanese winners Ami Nakai at the Grand Prix de France and Mao Shimada at Skate Canada International over the past two weeks.
"I was really nervous, but I remembered how much I love figure skating," said Chiba, who was flawless apart from landing her triple Lutz a quarter rotation short in a late combination.
"During the performance, I was able to trust myself and stay focused throughout. I was able to show what I've been working on in training."
Individual Neutral Athlete Alexandra Ignatova, the 2022 Winter Olympics silver medalist from Russia, topped the free skate on 148.90 after landing her opening quadruple Lutz. She came second overall on 221.27 and South Korea's Lee Hae In third on 210.79.
Chiba, who finished fourth at the Milan-Cortina Winter Olympics, sprained her right ankle in July and was sidelined for about a month before her recent resurgence.
"I'm relieved to be over the hump," she said. "My anxiety still seeps out during performances. I want to make adjustments so I can skate with full confidence."
Japan's Mako Yamashita was sixth on 193.32 and Rinka Watanabe 11th in the field of 12.
In pairs, Japan's Yuna Nagaoka and Sumitada Moriguchi won bronze for their first podium finish in the Grand Prix Series after finishing fourth in Friday's short program and third in Saturday's free skate for 181.50 overall.
"We've been practicing to get a medal at any cost, hoping to go for a place at the Grand Prix Final. It was really nice to be on the podium," said Nagaoka, who suffered a stress fracture in her right heel in April before fracturing her left foot in August in a traffic accident.
Anastasia Mishina and Aleksandr Galliamov from Russia won on 209.84, with Georgia's Anastasiia Metelkina and Luka Berulava second on 198.27.

zh_title: 安斯泰来在中国监狱的日本员工将于 12 月获释

content:
安斯泰来在中国监狱的日本员工将于 12 月获释
安斯泰来在中国监狱的日本员工将于 12 月获释
- 2026年11月7日 - 21:16 全部,日本,世界
图为2025年3月北京人民大会堂前的监控摄像头。（共同社）==共同社
熟悉日中关系的消息人士周六表示，因从事间谍活动而被关押在中国监狱的安斯泰来制药公司一名日本员工预计将于 12 月获释。
日本制药公司男员工，60多岁，2023年3月被拘留，2025年7月被北京市第二中级人民法院判处有期徒刑三年零六个月。
他将服完全部刑期，其中包括从他被拘留到作出裁决之间的部分时间。消息人士称，他可能会在预期释放后立即被驱逐到日本。
自日本首相高市早苗涉台言论引发外交争端以来，中日关系持续紧张。
该男子在计划返回日本之前被拘留。一名旁听庭审的日本外交官表示，应被定罪男子的要求，他无法透露裁决的细节。
其他知情人士称，在中国当局向他解释了认罪并从轻判刑的法律程序后，他承认了有罪。
他曾担任该制药公司中国部门的高管以及中国日本商工会议所的高级官员。
今年早些时候，富士电机公司的两名日本员工在中国被拘留，可能是因为试图将稀土相关产品运往海外，此前北京方面加强了对运往日本的包括稀土在内的民用和军用两用物品的控制。
日本政府后来证实，他们于 5 月在东北港口城市大连被拘留，原因是涉嫌违反走私违禁货物进出日本的法律，但出于隐私原因，没有透露更多细节。

Astellas' Japanese employee in Chinese prison to be released in Dec.
Astellas' Japanese employee in Chinese prison to be released in Dec.
- Nov 07, 2026 - 21:16 All,Japan,World
Photo shows security cameras in front of the Great Hall of the People in Beijing in March 2025. (Kyodo)==Kyodo
A Japanese employee of Astellas Pharma Inc. held in a Chinese prison for spying is expected to be released in December, sources close to Japan-China relations said Saturday.
The male employee of the Japanese pharmaceutical company, who is in his 60s and was detained in March 2023, was sentenced by Beijing No. 2 Intermediate People's Court in July 2025 to three years and six months in prison.
He would be serving his entire sentence, which includes part of the period between his detention and the ruling. He is likely to be deported to Japan immediately after the expected release, according to the sources.
Sino-Japanese tensions have remained high since a diplomatic row over Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi's remarks on Taiwan.
The man was detained just ahead of his scheduled return to Japan. A Japanese diplomat who attended the trial had said that he could not reveal details of the ruling at the request of the convicted man.
Other sources familiar with the matter have said he pleaded guilty after Chinese authorities explained to him the legal process of a guilty plea leading to a lighter sentence.
He had served as an executive at the pharmaceutical company's Chinese unit and a senior official of the Japanese Chamber of Commerce and Industry in China.
Earlier this year, two Japanese employees of Fuji Electric Co. were detained in China possibly over attempts to take rare earth-related products overseas, after Beijing strengthened controls on Japan-bound shipments of dual-use items that can be used for both civilian and military purposes, including rare earths.
The Japanese government later confirmed their detention in May in the northeastern port city of Dalian for allegedly violating a law on smuggling prohibited goods into or out of the country, without disclosing further details for privacy reasons.

title: US Air Force eyes reviving WWII air bases in the Pacific
zh_title: 美国空军着眼于复兴太平洋地区的二战空军基地
summary: 据美国空军部发布的公告称，美国空军希望每年在西北太平洋三个美国岛屿上的四个机场执行超过 6000 架次的飞机行动，其中包括一个正在翻新的二战时期主要机场。该部门发布了一份准备环境影响报告的意向通知，该报告将评估塞班国际机场、天宁岛国际机场、天宁岛北机场和罗塔国际机场的培训和运营的“潜在社会、经济和环境影响”。岛屿
content:
据美国空军部发布的公告称，美国空军希望每年在西北太平洋三个美国岛屿上的四个机场执行超过 6000 架次的飞机行动，其中包括一个正在翻新的二战时期主要机场。该部门发布了一份准备环境影响报告的意向通知，该报告将评估塞班国际机场、天宁岛国际机场、天宁岛北机场和罗塔国际机场的培训和运营的“潜在社会、经济和环境影响”。这些岛屿是北马里亚纳群岛联邦的一部分，是美国的非建制领土。拟议的训练和演习将支持空军的敏捷作战作战概念，该概念强调部队在机场之间的分散以及在各种条件下维持作战的同时在机场之间进行机动的能力，目的是挫败对手通过瞄准单个基地来关闭这些作战的能力。众所周知，ACE 的发展很大程度上是为了应对中国军队不断扩大的影响力和不断扩大的导弹库。
通知称，这四个机场为支持 ACE 提供了“独特的机会”，其基础设施从“完全开发的商业机场到远征作战地点”各不相同。这三个岛屿彼此相距不到几十海里，这将允许进行反映分布式行动复杂性的训练，同时减少它们之间的运输时间。它们距离美国另一个领土关岛的主要军事基地以北不到100海里，该基地将为这些演习提供部队的集结和部署。通知中写道，这三个机场“共同提供了一个训练环境，使[空军]能够进行分布式作战、测试和使用可定制的部队包、加强保障和机动能力以及增强作战弹性”。环境影响报告将评估拟议活动的潜在影响，其中包括每年举行几次、每次为期几周的小型、中型和大型训练和演习，包括每年在每个机场进行多达 1,200 次固定翼和 320 次旋转翼操作，例如起飞和着陆。
它还将评估替代方案，即每个机场每年最多进行 1,400 次固定翼飞机和 384 次旋转翼飞机运行，以及“无行动替代方案”。训练和演习将由每个机场最多 550,000 加仑的燃料、每个机场最多 1,000 名人员、远征基础设施的临时安装、箔条和照明弹等弹药的处理以及支持服务以及训练和演习前后的活动提供支持。拟议的活动是在经过数年的升级相关机场的工作之后进行的，特别是天宁岛的机场，这些机场是在第二次世界大战。北机场在战后处于闲置状态，在 2023 年底开始修复工作时，大部分被植被覆盖。空军还升级了港口和道路基础设施、燃料管道和机场表面以及公用设施，以促进天宁岛的扩大行动。机场修复工作引起了空军领导人对资源和资金的一些疑问，特别是在与伊朗的战争提出了新的要求的情况下

【原文 English Original】
The U.S. Air Force hopes to conduct more than 6,000 aircraft operations annually at four airfields on three American islands in the northwest Pacific Ocean, including a major WWII-era airfield that is being refurbished , according to an announcement from the Department of the Air Force. The department published a notice of intent to prepare an environmental impact statement that will assess “potential social, economic, and environmental effects” of training and operations at Saipan International Airport, Tinian International Airport, Tinian North Field and Rota International Airport. The islands are part of the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands, an unincorporated U.S. territory. The proposed training and exercises will support the Air Force’s Agile Combat Operations concept, which emphasizes dispersal of forces across airfields and the ability to maneuver between them while sustaining operations under a range of conditions, with the goal of thwarting an adversary’s ability to shut down those operations by targeting a single base. ACE, as it’s known, has developed largely in response to the Chinese military’s growing reach and expanding missile arsenal.  The notice said the four airfields provide “a unique opportunity” to support ACE, with infrastructure that varies from “fully developed commercial airfields to expeditionary operating locations.” The three islands are within a few dozen nautical miles of each other, which would allow for training that reflects the complexity of distributed operations while reducing transit time between them. They are less than 100 nautical miles north of the major military bases on Guam, another U.S. territory, which would support the staging and deployment of forces for those exercises. The three airfields “collectively provide a training environment that enables [the Air Force] to exercise distributed operations, test and employ tailorable force packages, strengthen sustainment and maneuver capabilities, and enhance operational resilience,” the notice reads. The environmental impact statement will evaluate the potential effects of the proposed activities, which include small, medium and large trainings and exercises held several times a year for a few weeks at a time and consisting of up to 1,200 fixed-wing and 320 rotary-wing operations, like takeoffs and landings, annually at each airfield. It will also assess an alternative scenario with up to 1,400 fixed-wing and 384 rotary-wing operations per airfield annually and a “No Action Alternative.” The trainings and exercises would be supported by up to 550,000 gallons of fuel at each airfield, up to 1,000 personnel per airfield, the temporary installation of expeditionary infrastructure, the handling of munitions like chaff and flares, as well as support services and pre-and post-training and exercise activities.  The proposed activity comes after several years of work to upgrade the airfields in question, especially the airfields on Tinian, which were built and heavily used during WWII. North Field was inactive after the war and was largely covered with vegetation when the rehabilitation effort began in late 2023. The Air Force also upgraded port and roadway infrastructure, fuel pipelines and airfield surfaces, and utilities to facilitate expanded operations on Tinian . The airfield rehabilitation efforts have created some questions among Air Force leaders about resourcing and funding, particularly as the war with Iran has placed new demands on the force. Island residents also have misgivings about the projects. While some welcome the investment that the construction and military operations will bring, others have doubts that the increased activity will really benefit the islands’ populations and that the Pentagon will be transparent about its activity and responsive to local concerns.  The Department of the Air Force will hold public meetings this month on Saipan, Tinian and Rota to get feedback on the proposal, with written comments due by Nov. 29. The department plans to produce a draft environmental impact statement for public comment in fall 2027 and a final version in mid-2028.

title: Britain's tech ambitions depend on minerals made in China, MPs warn
zh_title: 议员警告称，英国的科技雄心依赖于中国制造的矿物
summary: 英国对人工智能、先进芯片和清洁能源的雄心依赖于中国主导的矿产供应链，议员们表示，他们无法确定部长们是否有可靠的计划来减少这种依赖。下议院商业、创新、科学和贸易委员会为部长们设定了十项测试，以确保关键矿物的安全。它的裁决并不乐观——它不能确信政府会通过其中任何一项。这些测试涵盖部长们是否知道哪些行业和技术需要保护、他们需要哪些矿物、哪些地方的供应可能会受到干扰，以及国内如何保护这些产业和技术。
content:
英国对人工智能、先进芯片和清洁能源的雄心依赖于中国主导的矿产供应链，议员们表示，他们无法确定部长们是否有可靠的计划来减少这种依赖。下议院商业、创新、科学和贸易委员会为部长们设定了十项测试，以确保关键矿物的安全。它的裁决并不乐观——它不能确信政府会通过其中任何一项。这些测试涵盖部长们是否知道哪些行业和技术需要保护、需要哪些矿产、哪些地方的供应可能会受到干扰，以及国内生产、海外合作伙伴关系、技能和融资将如何缩小差距。在今天发布的一份报告中，该委员会警告说，供应多样化将需要 10 到 15 年的时间，并且需要持续的投资以及与盟友的合作。报告称，将中国完全排除在外既不现实也不可取。让北京拥有如此大的影响力则是另一回事。关键矿物支撑着从电池和半导体到数据中心和军事设备的一切。该称号反映了它们的经济或安全重要性以及对供应中断的脆弱性，而不是一个特别独特的地质俱乐部的成员资格。英国与包括美国、欧盟、日本和印度在内的几乎所有主要工业化经济体一样，几乎完全依赖这些材料和矿产品的进口。
但在中国境外开采更多矿石只能解决部分问题。更大的瓶颈是加工。该委员会援引国际能源署的数据称，中国是 20 种战略矿产中 19 种的领先炼油国，平均市场份额为 70%。矿井上方的不同旗帜并不一定意味着通过炼油厂的不同路线。暴露的范围不仅仅限于芯片和电池。正如《The Register》八月份报道的那样，铒用于放大光纤链路中的信号，而钇则用于陶瓷电容器等组件。 IEEE Spectrum 警告说，中国实际上垄断了制造商所需的工业可用材料的加工。这种集中已经造成了破坏。中国于 2025 年 4 月在美国征收关税后实施稀土出口管制，波及制造业供应链，并迫使汽车工厂临时关闭。即使英国不是预定目标，英国制造商也可能遭受损失。该委员会还重点介绍了用于雷达、通信和电子战的先进半导体的镓和锗。报告显示，中国的产量分别占全球的 95% 和 93%。北京在芯片材料方面发挥影响力并不新鲜。随着西方对半导体技术的限制收紧，中国于 2023 年 7 月宣布了镓和锗的出口许可要求。
然而议员们表示，政府尚未明确确定要保护哪些国内工业和技术能力，因此很难确定哪些供应链值得优先考虑。进口统计数据也没有揭示全部风险。矿物质可能会进入电池、磁铁和其他制造部件内部，并作为单独的材料从视野中消失。企业本身可能并不确切地知道其供应链中的几层到底是什么。该委员会希望与c中的公司进行保密的映射和压力测试

【原文 English Original】
Britain's ambitions for AI, advanced chips, and clean energy rest on mineral supply chains dominated by China, and MPs say they cannot establish whether ministers have a credible plan to reduce that dependence. The House of Commons Business, Innovation, Science and Trade Committee has set ministers ten tests for securing critical minerals. Its verdict is hardly glowing – it cannot be confident the government passes any of them. The tests cover whether ministers know which industries and technologies need protecting, what minerals they require, where supplies could be disrupted, and how domestic production, overseas partnerships, skills, and financing will close the gaps. In a report published today , the committee warns that diversifying supplies will take ten to 15 years, and will require sustained investment and cooperation with allies. Completely cutting China out is neither realistic nor desirable, it says. Leaving Beijing with so much leverage is another matter. Critical minerals underpin everything from batteries and semiconductors to datacenters and military equipment. The designation reflects their economic or security importance and vulnerability to supply disruption, rather than membership of an especially exclusive geological club. The UK – like pretty much all major industrialized economies including the US, the EU, Japan, and India – is almost entirely dependent on imports of these materials and mineral product s. But digging up more ore outside China would solve only part of the problem. The bigger bottleneck is processing. Citing International Energy Agency figures, the committee says China is the leading refiner for 19 of 20 strategic minerals, with an average market share of 70 percent. A different flag over the mine does not necessarily mean a different route through the refinery. The exposure extends beyond chips and batteries. As The Register reported in August , erbium is used to amplify signals in fiber-optic links, while yttrium goes into components including ceramic capacitors. IEEE Spectrum warned that China effectively monopolized the processing of both into the industrially usable materials manufacturers need. That concentration has already caused disruption. China's rare earth export controls in April 2025 , introduced following US tariffs, rippled through manufacturing supply chains and forced temporary automotive plant closures. British manufacturers can suffer even when Britain isn't the intended target. The committee also highlights gallium and germanium, used in advanced semiconductors for radar, communications, and electronic warfare. China accounts for 95 percent and 93 percent of their global production respectively, according to the report [PDF]. Beijing flexing its leverage over chip materials is not new. China announced export licensing requirements for gallium and germanium in July 2023 amid tightening Western restrictions on semiconductor technology. Yet MPs say the government has not clearly identified which domestic industrial and technological capabilities it wants to protect, making it difficult to determine which supply chains deserve priority. Nor do import statistics reveal the whole exposure. Minerals can arrive inside batteries, magnets, and other manufactured components, disappearing from view as individual materials. Businesses themselves may not know precisely what lies several layers down their supply chains. The committee wants confidential mapping and stress-testing with firms in critical sectors, followed by joint purchasing arrangements with allies to give new mining and refining projects dependable customers. Committee chair Liam Byrne said: "Critical minerals are the alpha of the new economy. We cannot re-arm Britain, build AI or deliver net zero unless we secure the minerals these technologies depend on. "Yet sixteen years after China first weaponised its chokehold over rare earths , Britain remains dangerously exposed. We don't know enough about what minerals we need or where to find them. Our energy costs make processing uneconomic, we're exporting valuable metal waste, and our public finance institutions are shackled by outdated rules." More than a shopping list The committee's five-part prescription is to identify the capabilities Britain must protect, map their mineral needs, expand domestic mining, processing, and recycling, pool purchasing power with allies, and establish a dedicated financing facility. The proposed facility would bring together public funding bodies to back projects through grants, equity, loans, guarantees, and long-term purchase agreements. "We're never going to eliminate Chinese minerals from our supply chains. But it's foolish to leave Britain exposed to economic coercion when we could be building alternative supplies," Byrne said. "That's why we need a new Critical Minerals Finance Facility with the financial firepower to invest in new mines, processing plants and recycling, working with our allies to share the costs." The report argues that existing institutions leave gaps, particularly for early-stage projects. It recommends expanding UK Export Finance's remit and allowing British International Investment to take equity stakes in overseas mineral projects. Long-term purchasing commitments and price guarantees could help keep strategically important projects commercially viable despite volatile mineral prices. There is also material closer to home. The report says 80 percent of UK metal products classified as waste are exported. MPs want better sorting and separation infrastructure, alongside more detailed trade data to establish exactly what valuable scrap is leaving the country. For domestic projects, they recommend designated critical mineral clusters with permitting deadlines, help navigating approvals, energy support, and priority grid access. Stockpiles could provide a short-term buffer too. The committee calls for an initial reserve covering approximately 60 days of minerals needed for defense capabilities, while stressing that warehouses are no substitute for diversified supply. None of this offers a quick escape from dependence on China. The committee's argument is that Britain needs to decide what it must protect, work out what those industries actually consume, and help finance alternatives before the next disruption. "De-risking even a prudent proportion of our supplies will take over a decade. Britain cannot afford to drift," Byrne said. "We must act now before dangerous dependencies become strategic liabilities." ®

title: Australian miners rail against looming tax changes

content:
澳大利亚矿业高管和行业团体正在加大对联邦政府的压力，要求联邦政府免除矿产勘探者计划中的资本利得税（CGT）改革，他们警告称，这可能会损害投资并削弱该国的全球竞争力。财政部长吉姆·查尔默斯 (Jim Chalmers) 在 2026 年 5 月的联邦预算中宣布的改革将用成本基础指数化取代长期存在的 50% 资本利得税折扣，并对自 2027 年 7 月 1 日起产生的收益征收 30% 的最低税。政府向科技初创企业提供豁免，但在 9 月确认勘探公司不会获得同样的待遇。 “资本利得税太可怕了，”Evolution Mining (ASX: EVN) 创始人兼董事长 Jake Klein 在悉尼举行的国际矿业和资源大会 (IMARC) 上表示。这场争端发生之际，澳大利亚面临着绿地勘探不断减少和全球矿业资本竞争日益激烈的局面。行业领袖认为，改革将阻止投资者支持早期发现，可能会削弱支持未来矿产生产所需的项目管道。勘探面临风险 澳大利亚矿产委员会首席经济学家罗斯·兰比表示，改革未能认识到与矿产勘探相关的高风险和低成功率。 “探索绝对至关重要。我们必须做更多的事情，”他告诉 IMARC 小组。
兰比表示，投资者接受了勘探企业亏损的可能性，因为成功的发现可以带来丰厚的回报。拟议的税收安排将减少这些潜在的回报。 “所以，这是糟糕的政策。我们已经要求政府像对待创新型初创企业一样对待初级探险家，并考虑到该行业的独特特征，给予该行业让步，但到目前为止，这一要求被置若罔闻。”西澳大利亚州矿产和能源商会首席执行官亚伦·莫雷表示，这些变化也与澳大利亚发展其关键矿产行业的雄心相冲突。莫雷指出，安东尼·阿尔巴内塞总理访问白宫，与美国官员的讨论重点是推进矿产项目。 “这项政策从根本上违背了这一愿景，”他说。采矿和勘探公司协会也对改革提出了挑战。尽管政府已就该立法展开新一轮磋商，但该协会警告称，如果不进行实质性修改，这一过程将毫无意义。行业影响 此前曾批评澳大利亚政府政策的克莱因表示，税收改革是该行业面临的几项政策阻力之一。他说：“像我 30 年前那样，今天开始职业生涯的人，没有理由表现得比我差 25%，这完全没有道理。”
Westgold Resources (ASX/TSX: WGX)董事总经理Wayne Bramwell将拟议的改革描述为“自己的目标”，会损害澳大利亚的勘探行业。“联邦关于资本利得税的决定——以不同于初创企业的方式对待澳大利亚的勘探——绝对会给这个国家带来糟糕的结果，”他在IMARC间隙表示。布拉姆韦尔表示，这种影响已经在西澳大利亚州显现出来，西澳大利亚州是该国最大的勘探支出目的地。 “这个国家最大的勘探资金目的地已经开始枯竭，因为现在从事高风险工作的人都没有工作。

【原文 English Original】
Australian mining executives and industry groups are intensifying pressure on the federal government to exempt mineral explorers from planned capital gains tax (CGT) changes they warn could undermine investment and weaken the country’s global competitiveness. The reforms, announced by Treasurer Jim Chalmers in the May 2026 federal budget, would replace the longstanding 50% CGT discount with cost base indexation and a 30% minimum tax on gains accruing from July 1, 2027. The government granted exemptions to technology start-ups but confirmed in September that exploration companies would not receive the same treatment. “The capital gains tax is terrible,” Evolution Mining (ASX: EVN) founder and chairman Jake Klein said during the International Mining and Resources Convention (IMARC) in Sydney. The dispute comes as Australia faces declining greenfields exploration and growing competition for global mining capital. Industry leaders argue the reforms would discourage investors from backing early-stage discoveries, potentially weakening the pipeline of projects needed to support future mineral production. Exploration at risk Minerals Council of Australia chief economist Ross Lambie said the reforms failed to recognize the high risks and low success rates associated with mineral exploration. “Exploration is absolutely critical. We’ve got to be doing more of it,” he told an IMARC panel. Lambie said investors accepted the possibility of losing money on exploration ventures because successful discoveries could deliver substantial returns. The proposed tax arrangements would diminish those potential rewards. “So, this is bad policy. We have asked the government to treat junior explorers the same as what they want to treat innovative start-ups and give the industry a concession, given the unique characteristics it has, but so far, that’s fallen on deaf ears.” Chamber of Minerals and Energy of Western Australia CEO Aaron Morey said the changes also conflicted with Australia’s ambitions to develop its critical minerals industry. Morey pointed to Prime Minister Anthony Albanese’s visit to the White House , where discussions with US officials focused on advancing minerals projects. “That is a policy that is fundamentally at odds with that vision,” he said. The Association of Mining and Exploration Companies has also challenged the reforms. Although the government has opened another round of consultation on the legislation, the association warned the process would be meaningless without substantive changes. Industry fallout Klein, who has previously criticized Australian government policy , said the tax overhaul was among several policy headwinds confronting the sector. “There is no reason why someone starting their career today, as I did 30 years ago, is going to do 25% worse than I did – that just makes no sense at all,” he said. Westgold Resources (ASX/TSX: WGX) managing director Wayne Bramwell described the proposed changes as an “own goal” that would damage Australia’s exploration industry. “Federal decisions around capital gains tax – treating exploration in Australia differently than start-ups – absolutely leads to a bad outcome for this country,” he said on the sidelines of IMARC. Bramwell said the effects were already emerging in Western Australia, the country’s largest destination for exploration spending. “The largest destination for exploration dollars in this country has started to dry up because the people doing the high-risk work now are not being rewarded for that,” he said. He warned that the consequences could extend well beyond the immediate investment cycle, potentially damaging the exploration ecosystem for years. “That’s a real concern for me, thinking that our ecosystem has been damaged long-term by that decision. It can be reversed because we absolutely need the explorers to explore.” The latest consultation gives the government another opportunity to reconsider the treatment of junior explorers before the reforms take effect in July 2027. Whether it grants the sector relief could influence Australia’s ability to attract the risk capital needed to discover its next generation of mines.

content:
日本举行模拟泊核电站事故的核灾难演习 - 日本时报
日本举行模拟泊核电站事故的核灾难演习
周六，首相高市早苗（中）在总理大臣官邸举行的综合核灾难准备演习中发表讲话。 |集集
X Facebook LinkedIn Reddit Bluesky Threads 电子邮件 打印 书签故事 复制链接
日本政府周六进行了一次全面的核应急演习，模拟了日本最北端县北海道电力公司泊核电站发生的严重事故。
这次为期三天的演习将持续到周日，参与者包括北海道县政府、相关市镇和内阁府。此次演习包括十年来首次在泊工厂进行的演习。预计约有 8,500 名当地居民参加。
此次演习的场景是，北海道西海岸发生地震，导致核电站3号反应堆设备故障，导致冷却系统无法运行。
演习第二天，日本首相高市早苗宣布进入核紧急状态。一些参与者运送了被认为受到辐射的人员，另一些参与者则通过视频会议系统召开了对策会议。
2025年，原子能监管局得出结论，泊港核电站3号反应堆符合该国新的安全标准，这是其重启的先决条件。
当局仍在审查涵盖反应堆设施详细设计的施工计划，反应堆重启的时间仍不确定。
在当地居民要求停止泊港工厂运营的诉讼中，札幌地方法院部分批准了原告的请求，并于 2022 年发布了禁令。札幌高等法院计划于明年 1 月做出上诉裁决。

Japan holds nuclear disaster drill simulating Tomari plant accident
Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi (center) speaks during a comprehensive nuclear disaster preparedness drill at the Prime Minister’s Office on Saturday. | JIJI
X Facebook LinkedIn Reddit Bluesky Threads Email Print Bookmark story Copy link
The government on Saturday conducted a comprehensive nuclear emergency drill simulating a severe accident at Hokkaido Electric Power’s Tomari nuclear plant in Japan’s northernmost prefecture.
The three-day drill, which runs through Sunday, involves the Hokkaido prefectural government, relevant municipalities and the Cabinet Office. The drill includes exercises conducted at the Tomari plant for the first time in 10 years. About 8,500 local residents are expected to take part.
The drill is based on a scenario in which an earthquake off the western coast of Hokkaido causes equipment failure at the plant’s No. 3 reactor, rendering its cooling system inoperable.
On the second day of the exercise, Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi declared a nuclear emergency. While some participants transported people assumed to have been exposed to radiation, others held a countermeasures meeting through a video conferencing system.
In 2025, the Nuclear Regulation Authority concluded that the No. 3 reactor at the Tomari plant met the country’s new safety standards, a prerequisite for its restart.
The authority is still reviewing a construction plan covering the detailed design of the reactor’s facilities, and the timing of the reactor’s restart remains uncertain.
In a lawsuit filed by local residents seeking a halt to the Tomari plant’s operation, Sapporo District Court partially granted the plaintiffs’ request and issued an injunction in 2022. Sapporo High Court is scheduled to hand down its appellate ruling in January next year.

content:
花样滑冰：日本三浦知良夺得中国杯冠军并晋级大奖赛决赛
花样滑冰：日本三浦知良夺得中国杯冠军并晋级大奖赛决赛
- 2026年11月8日 - 17:52 全部,体育
2026年11月8日，在深圳举行的中国杯花样滑冰锦标赛上，日本选手三浦花王（中）夺得男子滑冰冠军。（共同社）==共同社
日本选手三浦花王于2026年11月8日在深圳举行的中国杯花样滑冰男子自由项目上表演。（共同社）==共同社
中国深圳——周日，日本选手三浦花在中国杯花样滑冰锦标赛上夺得男子冠军，获得下个月大奖赛决赛的参赛资格。
周五的短节目结束后，三浦知良在本赛季大奖赛系列赛的第三场比赛——深圳举行的自由滑比赛中取得了190.35分的个人最好成绩，总成绩为293.25分。
21岁的三浦知良参加了今年的米兰科尔蒂纳奥运会，并在上个月的大奖赛系列赛揭幕战法国大奖赛上获得了第二名。
“我真的很高兴，”三浦说。 “这次特别好的一点是我能够顺利通过比赛，总体上没有出现任何重大失误。”
“我的成绩还有提高的空间，”他说。 “我想继续为大奖赛决赛努力训练。”
三浦知良的同胞、米兰科蒂纳奥运会男单铜牌得主佐藤俊获得第四名，结束了他连续第三届中国杯冠军的争夺。
在其他参赛者中，来自俄罗斯的个人中立运动员弗拉迪斯拉夫·迪基吉（Vladislav Dikidzhi）和叶夫根尼·谢梅年科（Evgeni Semenenko）分别获得第二名和第三名。
大奖赛决赛将于 12 月在中国重庆举行，根据大奖赛系列赛中获得的积分，排名前六的滑冰选手将参赛。

Figure skating: Japan's Miura wins Cup of China, earns berth at GP Final
Figure skating: Japan's Miura wins Cup of China, earns berth at GP Final
- Nov 08, 2026 - 17:52 All,Sports
Japan's Kao Miura (C) wins the men's title at the figure skating Cup of China in Shenzhen on Nov. 8, 2026. (Kyodo)==Kyodo
Japan's Kao Miura performs during the men's free program at the figure skating Cup of China in Shenzhen on Nov. 8, 2026. (Kyodo)==Kyodo
SHENZHEN, China - Japan's Kao Miura won the men's title at the figure skating Cup of China on Sunday, earning a berth in next month's Grand Prix Final.
Standing top after Friday's short program, Miura recorded personal-best scores of 190.35 points in the free skate and 293.25 overall in Shenzhen, where the third event of this season's Grand Prix Series was staged.
The 21-year-old Miura, who competed in this year's Milan Cortina Olympics, finished second at last month's Grand Prix de France, the opening event of the Grand Prix Series.
"I'm really happy," Miura said. "What was especially good this time was that I was able to get through the competition without any major mistakes overall."
"I still have room to improve my scores," he said. "I want to continue training hard for the Grand Prix Final."
Miura's compatriot, Shun Sato, the Milan Cortina Olympic bronze medalist in the men's singles event, finished fourth, ending his bid for a third consecutive Cup of China title.
Among other competitors, Individual Neutral Athletes Vladislav Dikidzhi and Evgeni Semenenko, both from Russia, finished second and third, respectively.
The Grand Prix Final, to be held in China's Chongqing in December, will feature the top six skaters based on points earned during the Grand Prix Series.

content:
香港开始公开招聘新建筑维修机构首席执行官|中国劳工公告栏
2026 年 11 月 9 日星期一 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
香港开始公开招聘新建筑维修机构首席执行官
香港楼宇维修支援及服务局已开始公开招聘行政总裁，初步人员编制接近100人。该局计划于2026年底前完成登记和董事会任命，于2027年1月开始指派检查顾问，并启动项目
2026 年 11 月 8 日 17:56 香港时间 · 更新于 11 月 9 日 04:26 · 阅读时间 1 分钟
发展局已确认屋宇维修支援及服务局行政总裁的公开招聘工作已展开。新成立的机构的主席和行政长官均由香港行政长官任命。该局在回应媒体询问时表示，遴选委员会主要由政府人员组成，任命程序将遵循与其他政府独资公司类似的程序，以确保公平和透明。
政府及市区重建局正协助该局逐步招聘人员。该局在初始运营阶段预计将有近100名员工，涵盖一系列职能，包括编制和管理资格预审名单、处理招标和评标案件、监控进度、开发和维护信息技术系统、客户服务、法律支持、行政和会计支持以及内部审计。
政府计划在2026年底前完成注册、董事会任命、办公室设立和租赁等准备工作。预计三份资格预审名单将于今年年底准备就绪，并从 2027 年 1 月开始指派验楼顾问。业主项目招标将于 2027 年第一季度内启动。当局将适时公布费用和补贴细节。

Hong Kong starts open recruitment for CEO of new building maintenance body | China Labour Bulletin Board
Monday, 9 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong starts open recruitment for CEO of new building maintenance body
Hong Kong's Building Maintenance Support and Services Bureau has begun publicly recruiting its chief executive, with initial staffing of nearly 100. The bureau aims to complete registration and board appointments by end of 2026, start assigning inspection consultants in January 2027 and launch proje
8 Nov 2026 at 17:56 HKT · updated 9 Nov, 04:26 · 1 min read
The Development Bureau has confirmed that the open recruitment for the chief executive of the Building Maintenance Support and Services Bureau has commenced. The chairman and chief executive of the newly established body are both appointed by the Chief Executive of Hong Kong. The selection committee is primarily composed of government personnel, and the appointment process will follow procedures similar to those for other wholly government-owned companies to ensure fairness and transparency, the bureau said in response to media enquiries.
The government and the Urban Renewal Authority are assisting the bureau in gradually recruiting staff. The bureau is expected to have nearly 100 employees in its initial operational phase, covering a range of functions including compiling and managing pre-qualification lists, handling tender and bid evaluation cases, monitoring progress, developing and maintaining information technology systems, customer services, legal support, administrative and accounting support, and internal auditing.
The government aims to complete preparatory work by the end of 2026, including registration, board appointments, office establishment and leasing. Three pre-qualification lists are expected to be ready by the end of the year, with building inspection consultants to be assigned starting January 2027. Project tenders for property owners will be launched within the first quarter of 2027. The authorities will announce fee and subsidy details in due course.

title: Taiwan says closes representative office in Papua New Guinea, blames China
zh_title: 台湾称关闭驻巴布亚新几内亚代表处，指责中国
summary: 台湾周五表示，已决定关闭驻巴布亚新几内亚代表处并撤回其工作人员，并指责中国对这个南太平洋国家的胁迫。 2021 年 10 月 6 日，台湾台北，国庆庆祝活动前，台湾国旗安装的全貌。资料照片：Walid Berrazeg/HKFP。台湾外交部表示，未来我们将向友好国家和其他有合作潜力、值得继续接触的地区配置相关资源，以进一步深化实质性合作，拓展台湾的国际空间。
content:
台湾周五表示，已决定关闭驻巴布亚新几内亚代表处并撤回其工作人员，并指责中国对这个南太平洋国家的胁迫。 2021 年 10 月 6 日，台湾台北，国庆庆祝活动前，台湾国旗安装的全貌。资料照片：Walid Berrazeg/HKFP。台湾外交部在一份声明中表示，未来我们将向友好国家和其他有合作潜力、值得继续接触的地区配置相关资源，以进一步深化实质性合作，拓展台湾的国际空间。巴布亚新几内亚7月份决定关闭台湾在首都莫尔兹比港的办事处，但台北拒绝了这一决定，引发了长达数月的争议。中国声称台湾是其领土的一部分，并反对台湾参与国际组织和与其他国家的交往，此前曾对巴布亚新几内亚的举动表示欢迎。与许多国家一样，巴布亚新几内亚与中国建立了正式外交关系，但允许台湾在莫尔兹比港设立代表处。台湾外交部周五表示，岛内民主正在“积极”关闭该办事处，撤回“所有派驻人员”，并审查和调整“双边合作关系”。
台湾表示，巴布亚新几内亚政府“最近的一系列行动”“严重破坏了双方长期合作建立的互信基础”。台湾台北，2024 年 1 月 12 日。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。 “这些行为也反映出中国持续利用政治压力和经济影响力干涉其他国家的外交决策，打压台湾的国际空间，”外交部表示。巴布亚新几内亚政府的决定再次凸显中国利用政治和经济手段干涉别国自主外交决策，破坏国际互信和公平原则。台湾此前宣布已停止从巴布亚新几内亚现货购买液化天然气，但周五该部表示也将不再与该国签署新的现货采购合同。外交部表示，台湾液化天然气采购量占巴布亚新几内亚出口量的三分之一。官方数据显示，到 2025 年，这个南太平洋国家占台湾天然气进口量的 8%，而卡塔尔（34%）、澳大利亚（33%）和美国（10%）。该部表示，台湾还将终止技术合作和援助计划，“包括医疗任务、相关奖学金和人才发展计划”。

【原文 English Original】
Taiwan said Friday it has decided to close its representative office in Papua New Guinea and withdraw its staff, blaming Chinese coercion of the South Pacific nation for the decision. General view of Taiwan flag installation ahead of National Day celebrations in Taipei, Taiwan, 06 October, 2021. File photo: Walid Berrazeg/HKFP. “In the future, we will allocate relevant resources to friendly nations and other regions with cooperative potential that warrant continued engagement, in order to further deepen substantive cooperation and expand Taiwan’s international space,” Taiwan’s foreign ministry said in a statement. The announcement comes after a months-long dispute following PNG’s decision in July to shutter Taiwan’s office in the capital Port Moresby, which Taipei rejected. China, which claims Taiwan is part of its territory and opposes the self-governed island’s participation in international organisations and exchanges with other countries, previously welcomed PNG’s move. Like many countries, PNG has formal diplomatic relations with China but had allowed Taiwan to have a representative office in the Port Moresby. Taiwan’s foreign ministry said on Friday the island democracy was “proactively” closing the office, withdrawing “all posted personnel” and reviewing and adjusting “bilateral cooperative relations”. Taiwan said “a series of recent actions” by the PNG government had “severely undermined the foundation of mutual trust built through long-term cooperation between the two sides”. Taipei, Taiwan, on January 12, 2024. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. “These actions also reflect China’s continued use of political pressure and economic influence to interfere in the diplomatic decisions of other countries and suppress Taiwan’s international space,” the ministry said. “The Papua New Guinea government’s decision once again highlights China’s use of political and economic means to interfere with other countries’ autonomous diplomatic decision-making and to undermine international mutual trust and the principles of fairness.” Taiwan previously announced that it had stopped spot purchases of liquefied natural gas from PNG, but on Friday the ministry said it also would no longer sign new spot purchase contracts with the country. The foreign ministry said Taiwanese LNG purchases accounted for one-third of PNG’s exports. The South Pacific Nation accounted for eight percent of Taiwan’s natural gas imports in 2025, compared with Qatar (34 percent), Australia (33 percent) and the United States (10 percent), official figures show. Taiwan will also end technical cooperation and assistance programmes, “including medical missions, related scholarship and talent development programmes”, the ministry said.

summary: 香港一家法院驳回了一名前新闻工会主席对其因妨碍警察执法而被判入狱五天的定罪提出最终上诉的请求。 2023 年 9 月 6 日，香港记者协会主席陈启宗在高等法院外。资料照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。高等法院暂委法官黄莉莉周五拒绝向香港记者协会（HKJA）前主席陈润生颁发向终审法院提出异议的证明书。陈试图推翻他在 2022 年 9 月遭遇的一次判决，当时他
content:
香港一家法院驳回了一名前新闻工会主席对其因妨碍警察执法而被判入狱五天的定罪提出最终上诉的请求。 2023 年 9 月 6 日，香港记者协会主席陈启宗在高等法院外。资料照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。高等法院暂委法官黄莉莉周五拒绝向香港记者协会（HKJA）前主席陈润生颁发向终审法院提出异议的证明书。陈先生于 2022 年 9 月在旺角报道业主委员会会议时拒绝向便衣警察出示身份证，因此试图推翻对他的定罪。他于 2023 年 9 月被定罪并被判处五天监禁，但在上诉期间获准保释。 5 月，陈在上诉失败后入狱服刑（同样由黄法官主持）。在寻求向最高法院上诉的证明时，陈的律师早些时候辩称，该市的《警察部队条例》是否授予警员要求身份证明的“独立权力”，是一个具有重大和普遍重要性的问题。 “没有合理的争议”，黄法官周五驳回了这一论点，并在一份中文判决书中表示，该法律“明确”授权警察拦截个人并要求提供身份证明。
法官表示，陈律师提出的论点无视明确的法律规定，实际上是试图剥夺警方索要身份证的权力。高等法院。资料照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。 “因此，我不认为所提出的论点是真正的法律论点。即使它是一个法律论点……我发现它没有合理的争议性，”法官写道。尽管周五作出裁决，陈仍然可以直接向终审法院上诉委员会申请上诉许可。陈先生于2021年至2024年期间担任记协主席。案发时，一名便衣警察拦住了陈先生，警察称陈先生的行为“可疑”，并要求出示他的身份证。尽管多次警告，但他拒绝这样做，随后被捕。在陈五月上诉失败并不得不服五天监禁后，记协表示“深感遗憾”，而记者无国界则表示对陈的入狱感到“愤怒”。

【原文 English Original】
A Hong Kong court has rejected a former press union head’s bid to lodge a final appeal against his conviction for obstructing police, for which he was jailed for five days. Hong Kong Journalists Association chairperson Ronson Chan outside the High Court on Sept. 6, 2023. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Deputy High Court Judge Lily Wong on Friday refused to grant Ronson Chan, a former chair of the Hong Kong Journalists Association (HKJA), a certificate to take his challenge to the Court of Final Appeal. Chan has sought to overturn his conviction stemming from an encounter in September 2022, when he refused to show his identity card to a plainclothes police officer while reporting on a homeowners’ committee meeting in Mong Kok. He was convicted in September 2023 and sentenced to five days in jail, but was granted bail pending an appeal. Chan served the prison term after losing the appeal – also presided over by Judge Wong – in May. In seeking certification to appeal to the top court, Chan’s lawyer had earlier argued that whether the city’s Police Force Ordinance grants officers “free-standing power” to demand identity proof is a question of great and general importance. ‘Not reasonably arguable’ Judge Wong on Friday rejected the argument, saying in a Chinese-language judgment that the law was “unequivocal” in empowering police officers to stop individuals and demand proof of identity. The argument presented by Chan’s lawyer ignored clear statutory provisions and effectively sought to strip police of their power to demand an identity card, the judge said. The High Court. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. “I therefore do not consider the argument presented to be a genuine legal argument. Even if it were a legal argument… I find that it is not reasonably arguable,” the judge wrote. Despite Friday’s ruling, Chan can still apply directly to the Court of Final Appeal’s Appeal Committee for leave to appeal. Chan was chair of the HKJA from 2021 to 2024. At the time of the offence, Chan was stopped by a plainclothes police officer who said he was acting “suspiciously” and asked to see his identification card. He was arrested after refusing to do so despite multiple warnings. The HKJA expressed “deep regret” after Chan lost his appeal in May and had to serve his five-day prison sentence, while Reporters Without Borders said it was “outraged” by Chan’s imprisonment.

content:
国民党高雄市长候选人柯志恩（右）11月7日在旗山举行第三场、也是最后一场“三山造势”，寻求连任的台北市长蒋万安南下站台助阵。“三山”指凤山、冈山和旗山，是原高雄县三大重要票仓，地方上历来有“得三山者得天下”的说法。 （柯志恩竞办提供）
台湾高雄市长选举蓝绿阵营同日造势，隔空较劲。国民党候选人柯志恩挟辩论后的声势催票，其阵营猛攻民进党新潮流系；民进党候选人赖瑞隆则获身兼民进党主席的总统赖清德亲自站台助选。
柯志恩阵营在10月30日的辩论后士气大振，内部评估若能推高投票率，柯志恩或有机会险胜。不过，学者分析，柯志恩面对绿营中央与地方执政资源的双重优势，要翻转这个绿色大本营，挑战不小。
刚刚过去的星期六（11月7日），柯志恩在高雄旗山举行第三场、也是最后一场“三山造势”，主办方称吸引逾2万人到场。寻求连任的台北市长蒋万安南下助阵，民众党主席黄国昌，前立法院长、柯志恩竞选总部主委王金平皆到场站台；民进党创党元老、前立法委员许国泰也现身助讲。
柯志恩致词时回应辩论后的声势，称自己过去四年走遍高雄各地，了解基层民众的心声，“不是我会讲话，是我要帮大家发声”。她也指出，高雄县市合并后资源分配不均，批评民进党自恃县区选民“票都会投给自己”而长期忽略地方建设。
53岁的旗山居民江小姐告诉《联合早报》，她认为民进党在高雄执政多年，但旗山地方建设不多，年轻人大多得离乡到外地工作。因此，她抱着“换党做做看”的心情，自发到场支持柯志恩。
黄国昌和许国泰将矛头指向民进党新潮流系。黄国昌批评，赖瑞隆虽自称“劳工之子”，但涉及劳工权益时，却听从党意或缺席投票，是典型的“新潮流投票部队”。黄国昌也表态，民众党将全力支持柯志恩。
许国泰指控新潮流在高雄市长党内初选期间抹黑同党立委林岱桦，批评“新潮流没有爱心”；蒋万安虽未点名新潮流系，但强调政治人物应对人民负责，而非对派系负责。
同一天、几乎同一时间，民进党候选人赖瑞隆也在高雄冈山举行造势活动，与柯志恩隔空较劲。赖清德第三度南下为他助选，高雄市长陈其迈、总统府秘书长潘孟安、内政部长刘世芳等也到场站台；民进党台北市长候选人沈伯洋则通过预录影片隔空助阵。
赖清德强调，高雄近年来的发展是中央与地方合作的成果，呼吁选民支持赖瑞隆接棒，让高雄继续进步，“绝对不走回头路”。赖瑞隆则承诺推动半导体封测中心、设立产业升级基金，并持续推进交通建设。
这也是柯志恩与赖瑞隆在辩论后，各自举行的首场大型造势活动。柯志恩阵营一名资深助选干部向《联合早报》形容，柯志恩在辩论中的表现“碾压”赖瑞隆，团队士气为之一振。
他同时分析，高雄长期由民进党执政，绿营基本盘大于蓝营，因此“胜负的关键在投票率”。他判断，如果投票率维持在上届约58%的水平，柯志恩就“没戏”；但如果能提高至66%至67%的水平，柯志恩便有险胜机会。
柯志恩阵营集中火力攻击民进党新潮流系，他解释：“打新潮流是一个战略上的思考。”赖瑞隆在民进党初选中击败的另外三名竞争者都不属于新潮流系，若能让这些人的支持者“心生不满”，在选举中作壁上观，削弱绿营的投票动员，同时设法提高柯志恩支持者的投票意愿，柯志恩便有机会一搏。
文化大学国际事务与中国大陆研究所兼任教授曲兆祥认为，柯志恩在辩论后的气势往上扬，“但还没到完全翻转（选情）的效果”。
他分析，柯志恩若能在投票前最后几周积极催票，营造败选危机感或胜选在望的迫切感，促使潜在的泛蓝选民出门投票，选情才可能出现变化。否则，即使赖瑞隆在辩论中“能犯的禁忌都犯了”，在绿营支持者投票率偏高的高雄，最终仍可能以些微差距胜出。
彰化师范大学公共事务与公民教育学系副教授刘兆隆则认为，柯志恩面对的不只是蓝绿基本盘悬殊的劣势。他形容，高雄选战是柯志恩“一个人的武林”，因为赖瑞隆有现任市长陈其迈的市政表现及绿营中央、地方执政资源支撑，“人家是一群人在打你一个”。
刘兆隆分析，国民党在高雄长期缺乏政治人才的培养，过去具有动员能力的地方派系也逐渐没落，能推出并成功当选的候选人越来越少，基层组织动员能力也随之下降。
他认为，国民党昔日重量级人物的政治影响力已不如前，党内缺乏能够为柯志恩拉抬选情的大老。即使王金平亲自出任柯志恩竞选总部主委，能够提供的奥援仍相当有限。

summary: 香港保安局局长邓克里斯表示，当局将在本月晚些时候的悲剧周年纪念日向那些希望纪念宏福苑火灾遇难者的人们提供帮助，前提是此类活动“合法”。保安局局长邓克里斯。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。唐在周四的一次活动中向记者发表讲话时发表了上述讲话，距离致命火灾一周年纪念日还有大约三周。去年11月26日，该小区大规模翻修工程中发生火灾，吞噬了7栋楼房，造成168人死亡。
content:
香港保安局局长邓克里斯表示，当局将在本月晚些时候的悲剧周年纪念日向那些希望纪念宏福苑火灾遇难者的人们提供帮助，前提是此类活动“合法”。保安局局长邓克里斯。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。唐在周四的一次活动中向记者发表讲话时发表了上述讲话，距离致命火灾一周年纪念日还有大约三周。去年11月26日，该村大规模翻修工程中发生大火，吞噬了7栋大楼，造成168人死亡、4600多名居民流离失所。 “很多家人和朋友都想纪念这一天，我们完全理解这一点。只要是合法的行动，我们都会尽力提供便利，”唐说。去年火灾发生后，香港人在广福休憩处设立了一个临时守夜地点，该休憩处是遭受火灾破坏的宏福苑附近的一个公园。火灾发生几天后，经过与警方的协调，该处已被清理干净。同样在悲剧发生后，政府发布的一份新闻稿猛烈抨击“反华势力和不稳定势力”“发表毫无根据的诽谤性言论”，并试图借火“煽动社会混乱”。 2025 年 12 月 8 日，志愿者在宏福村附近的休息区为大埔火灾受害者移走鲜花、留言和其他悼念品。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。
警察国家安全局总警司李志强在火灾发生后表示，他曾到过大埔现场，他认为“情况越来越像‘黑衣暴力’”，指的是2019年民主示威者所穿的衣服。另见：大埔火灾：警方监督连夜清除鲜花、志愿者和政府工作人员向纪念碑致敬的活动。他指出，“基本上是‘黑衣暴力’的小册子和标语”与灾难无关，只是为了煽动仇恨。”中国政府以及北京负责香港事务的最高办公室继续引用一种说法，指责某些行为者利用这场悲剧作为借口，在火灾发生后的几个月里制造混乱。唐周四表示：“我相信，如果依法处理，我们一定会提供帮助。”唐还重申了政府的部分改革建议，并表示当局将采取多管齐下的方法，包括提出立法修正案和协调执法机构，以防止未来串通投标。

【原文 English Original】
Authorities will assist people wishing to commemorate the victims of the Wang Fuk Court blaze on the tragedy’s anniversary later this month, on the condition that such activities are “lawful,” Hong Kong security chief Chris Tang has said. Secretary for Security Chris Tang. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Tang made the remarks when addressing reporters at an event on Thursday, some three weeks ahead of the first anniversary of the deadly fire. The blaze broke out on November 26 last year, engulfing seven buildings in the subsidised housing estate during large-scale renovation works, killing 168 people and displacing over 4,600 residents. “Many family members and friends want to commemorate this day and we fully understand this. We will do our best to facilitate any actions as long as they are handled lawfully,” Tang said. In the wake of the blaze last year, Hongkongers set up a makeshift vigil site at the Kwong Fuk Sitting-out Area, a park near the fire-ravaged Wang Fuk Court. It was cleared out days after the fire following coordination with the police. ‘In accordance with the law’ Also in the wake of the tragedy, a government press release blasted “anti-China and destabilising forces” for “making unfounded and slanderous remarks,” and trying to use the fire to “stir up chaos in society.” Volunteers remove flowers, messages and other tributes for Tai Po fire victims at a rest area near Wang Fuk Estate on December 8, 2025. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Chief Superintendent of the police’s National Security Department Steve Li said after the fire that he had visited the Tai Po site and that he believed “the situation was becoming more and more like that of ‘black-clad violence,'” in reference to clothing worn by 2019 pro-democracy demonstrators. See also: Tai Po fire: Police oversee overnight removal of flowers, tributes from memorial by volunteers, gov’t staff He pointed to pamphlets and slogans that were “basically unrelated to the disaster and only aimed to incite hatred.” The government — and Beijing’s top office on Hong Kong affairs — has continued to reference a narrative accusing certain actors of using the tragedy as a pretence for sowing chaos in the months since the fire. Tang said on Thursday: “I believe that if they are handled in accordance with the law, we will certainly assist.” Tang also reiterated part of the government’s reform proposals, saying that the authorities would adopt a multi-pronged approach including introducing legislative amendments and coordinating law enforcement agencies to prevent bid-rigging in the future.

zh_title: 购买，不要偷窃：认知战的经济学
source: Small Wars Journal by Arizona State Univ
summary: 摘要 认知战以个人数据为基础，而美国以低廉的价格出售大部分数据。这篇文章做了三件事：（1）中国为美国选民档案支付的价格； (2) 将其与秘密收集的记录成本进行比较； (3) 提出五项提高对手购买弹药成本的行动。中国购买美国选民数据并不是为了阅读它。它购买了用于瞄准引擎的原材料。商业广告花了二十年的时间来证明，足够大的个人数据池，通过预测模型运行，可以向人们传递不同的、量身定制的信息。
content:
摘要 认知战以个人数据为基础，而美国以低廉的价格出售大部分数据。这篇文章做了三件事：（1）中国为美国选民档案支付的价格； (2) 将其与秘密收集的记录成本进行比较； (3) 提出五项提高对手购买弹药成本的行动。中国购买美国选民数据并不是为了阅读它。它购买了用于瞄准引擎的原材料。商业广告花了二十年的时间来证明，足够大的个人数据池通过预测模型运行，可以向每个人传递不同的、量身定制的信息。将机器指向人们的恐惧和忠诚度而不是购物习惯，其结果就是认知战：通过数据精确地塑造人们的信念和决策方式的竞赛。该杂志的一篇配套文章认为，认知战是基于数据的，因此认知防御是从数据层开始的。这篇文章对那个战场进行了定价。白宫于 2026 年 7 月发布的一份解密记录显示，这些原材料几乎不需要花费任何成本，因为其中大部分都是合法出售的。获取的算术 在早期关于复合战争经济学的著作中，我提出了成本不对称比率，即对手的进攻单位成本除以防御者的反应成本，作为现代冲突中财政消耗的衡量标准。
一架“沙赫德”单向攻击无人机的成本约为 35,000 美元，根据谁的估计，其价格浮动为 15,000 美元，而国会研究服务处定价约为 400 万美元的爱国者拦截机。战略与国际研究中心 (CSIS) 在分析俄罗斯无人机袭击时，采用了同样的 35,000 美元中间值作为故意保守的数字。这种交换比对抗防守者的 100 比 1 更好。在该研究中，14 个典型威胁配对中有 12 个对攻击者有利。解密的材料允许在不同的领域进行相同的分析：情报获取。结果更糟：交易所对攻击者的支持更大。从购买数据的成本开始。美国每个州和哥伦比亚特区都会出售或发布其选民档案。加州将整个文件的费用上限为 100 美元，对于大约 2200 万条记录来说，相当于每个选民的千分之二美分。阿拉巴马州的收费最高，每个名字收费 1 美分，即全州名单收费约 38,000 美元。 11 个州根本不收取任何费用，根据选举援助委员会 2020 年编制的数据，24 个州对全州范围内的文件收取 1 至 1,000 美元之间的费用。直接从各州收集的完整国家档案最多可达六位数。中国支付的费用比这个少。
解密文件中最清晰的文件是一份网络防御通知，记录了一名中国行为者于2022年1月从美国商业网站下载了六个州的选民档案，并声明该信息“可从商业网站公开下载”。没有国家费用，没有入侵，没有利用。边际获取成本是带宽和分析师时间。偷窃的成本是多少 这种隐蔽的替代方案有一个价格表，而且这一次是公开的。当司法部于 2025 年 3 月起诉 10 名中国公民代表中国政府进行黑客攻击时，指控文件中描述了承包商 i-Soon 向中国情报机构收取的每个电子邮件费用为 10,000 至 75,000 美元

【原文 English Original】
Abstract Cognitive warfare runs on personal data, and the United States sells much of that data for pennies. This essay does three things: (1) prices what China paid for American voter files; (2) compares that to the documented cost of covert collection; and (3) proposes five actions that raise an adversary’s cost to buy the ammunition. China did not buy American voter data to read it. It bought raw material for a targeting engine. Commercial advertising spent two decades proving that a large enough pool of personal data, run through predictive models, delivers a different, tailored message to each individual. Point that machinery at a population’s fears and loyalties instead of its shopping habits, and the result is cognitive warfare: the contest to shape what a people believes and how it decides, made precise by data. A companion essay in this journal argued that cognitive warfare runs on data, and that cognitive defense therefore begins at the data layer. This essay prices that battlefield. A declassified record that the White House released in July 2026 shows that the raw material cost almost nothing, because most of it was legally for sale. The Arithmetic of Acquisition In earlier work on compound warfare economics, I proposed the Cost Asymmetry Ratio, the adversary’s offensive unit cost divided by the defender’s response cost, as a measure of fiscal attrition in modern conflict. A Shahed one-way attack drone costs roughly $35,000, give or take $15,000 depending on whose estimate one credits, and forces a Patriot interceptor that the Congressional Research Service prices at roughly $4 million. The Center for Strategic and International Studies (CSIS) adopted that same $35,000 midpoint as a deliberately conservative figure when analyzing Russian drone strikes. The exchange runs better than 100-to-1 against the defender. In that study, 12 of 14 canonical threat pairings favor the attacker. The declassified materials permit the same analysis in a different domain: intelligence acquisition. The results are worse: the exchange favors the attacker by an even wider margin. Start with what the data costs to buy. Every US state and the District of Columbia sells or releases its voter file. California caps the fee for its entire file at $100, which for roughly 22 million records works out to about a two-thousandth of a cent per voter. Alabama, at the expensive end, charges one cent per name, or roughly $38,000 for its statewide list. Eleven states charge nothing at all, and according to Election Assistance Commission data compiled in 2020, 24 states charged between $1 and $1,000 for a statewide file. A complete national file assembled directly from the states runs to the low six figures at most. China paid less than that. The clearest document in the declassified release, a network-defense notice , records a Chinese actor downloading the voter files of six states from US commercial websites in January 2022 and states that the information “is publicly available for download from the commercial websites.” No state fee, no intrusion, no exploit. The marginal acquisition cost was bandwidth and analyst hours. What Stealing Costs The covert alternative has a price list, and for once it is public. When the Justice Department indicted 10 Chinese nationals in March 2025 for hacking on behalf of the Chinese government, the charging documents described the contractor i-Soon billing Chinese intelligence services between $10,000 and $75,000 for each email inbox it successfully compromised, with further payments for analyzing the contents. Leaked internal files from the same company, analyzed by SentinelOne in 2024, show data from a foreign ministry fetching roughly $55,000. i-Soon employed over 100 people and projected revenues near $75 million. Those are the discount rates for soft targets, accounts and networks protected by ordinary commercial security. Hard targets are devices and systems that can only be breached with novel unpublished exploits. The exploit brokers that supply state programs publish their bids: up to $7 million for a full-chain iPhone compromise, $5 million for Android. RAND’s study of zero-day vulnerabilities found a median useful life near seven years, which is the asset an intelligence service burns when an operation is discovered. Above all of it sits a national intelligence budget the Director of National Intelligence discloses only as a top line, $73.4 billion requested for fiscal 2025, with everything below that classified. Set the routes side by side. Ten thousand dollars per inbox is the cheapest documented rate for stealing personal data one target at a time. One hundred dollars buys the registration record of every voter in California. The asymmetry is three to four orders of magnitude in direct cost, and that is before risk is priced at all. Covert collection carries indictment, attribution, sanctions, and the loss of tools that took years to build. A commercial download carries none. The defender’s side of the ratio is worse still. Equifax agreed to a settlement of at least $575 million and potentially $700 million for a breach affecting 147 million people. UnitedHealth Group reported that the Change Healthcare attack would cost roughly $2.87 billion in 2024. A breach of the Office of Personnel Management compromised background investigation files on 21.5 million people, including 5.6 million sets of fingerprints, at a national security cost no settlement figure captures. On the kinetic battlefield, an attacker spends a dollar to force thousands. In the data domain, the attacker spends nothing to force billions, or, when the data is legally public, to force no response at all, because there is nothing to remediate and no one to indict. The Portfolio Is the Tell The declassified catalog of data held by a People’s Republic of China computer network exploitation actor around 2019 reads as my cost-asymmetry framework predicts. Most of its American entries are cheap or free: voter files, breached credentials circulating in criminal dumps, social media account data, the commodity substrate of identity resolution. A small number of entries fall into a different category: F-15 maintenance and technical manuals, and documents from four cleared defense contractors. Technical data tied to items on the United States Munitions List cannot be bought at any price, which is precisely why it was stolen. That split is what a rational collector produces. Commodity data is purchased or scraped because covert action against it would be economically irrational. Export-controlled technical data is stolen because no legal market exists. Expensive, risky tradecraft is reserved for the material money cannot buy. An intelligence service that behaves this way is optimizing, and the results of that optimization are reflected in the price column. This reframes how the July release should be read. The alarming interpretation, that a 2022 download of public records constitutes an election compromise, misprices the event. The economic interpretation is more troubling: the United States has structured its data environment so that the cheapest route to a national targeting file on the American population runs through lawful commerce. The vulnerability is not a firewall. It is a fee schedule. Why the Cheapest Input Buys the Most Influence Cognitive warfare is the effort to shape a population’s perceptions, judgments, and decisions. Congress ordered the Department of War to define it in the 2026 National Defense Authorization Act , a task still unfinished months past its deadline, and this journal has carried a sustained debate over whether the term describes anything new. Set the doctrinal argument aside, and the mechanism is one the advertising industry already built. Gather enough data on a person, model what moves them, and serve a message calibrated to that individual. Advertising technology runs this logic billions of times a day to sell products. A state with the same pool of data does it to sell doubt and division, one citizen at a time, and adversaries are already contesting that space with AI-generated content at scale. The declassified materials indicate that China reasons this way. Beside the voter files sits a plan to exploit American fault lines over race, immigration, and the pandemic response, and to push tailored narratives through social and traditional media. Traditional propaganda involves broadcasting one message to everyone and hoping it lands. A data-driven campaign delivers a different message to each person, measures who responds, and adjusts. The difference is the objective. A retailer wants a purchase. An adversary wants a belief. Here the implications for scale turn the economics from severe to alarming. A broadcast’s reach is capped by its cost. A data-driven influence campaign’s is not, because once the pool of data exists, the marginal cost of one more tailored message approaches zero. China assembled that pool for pennies. The input to one of the most consequential forms of modern influence, the shaping of a democratic population’s decisions, is the cheapest item on the battlefield. Inverting the Curve In the kinetic domain, the fix for a bad exchange ratio is a cheaper defense: a laser shot costing a few dollars against a drone costing tens of thousands. The data domain has an analog, and it is regulatory, not technical. Executive Order 14117 and the Justice Department’s Data Security Program , in force since April 2025, function as an export control on Americans’ bulk sensitive data, restricting transfers to six countries of concern. The economic effect is the point. The rule raises the adversary’s acquisition cost at the cheapest point on the curve, the legal purchase, and pushes collection back toward the covert route, where cost, risk, and attribution all favor the defender. A dollar of acquisition cost imposed at the point of sale buys more security than a dollar of breach response after the loss. From Arithmetic to Action: Five Recommendations Five actions raise the adversary’s cost to acquire the ammunition of cognitive warfare. First, extend and enforce the bulk-data transfer restrictions. Close the reseller and aggregation seams through which restricted categories leak, and fund the enforcement capacity to detect violations, since an unenforced export control prices at zero. Second, reprice public records for bulk machine access. This does not require closing them. Transparency for citizens, journalists, campaigns, and researchers can coexist with fees, identity verification, and rate limits calibrated to make wholesale foreign harvesting expensive and visible. A journalist checking a voter roll and a foreign actor downloading 51 jurisdictions are different acts, and the fee schedule should treat them differently. Third, harden the holders whose data cannot be bought. As the legal route closes, adversary covert spending will concentrate on cleared defense contractors, health systems, and genomic repositories. Security investment should follow that predicted shift rather than trail it. Fourth, extend acquisition-cost logic to minors’ data. Behavioral and biometric profiles built on children age into profiles of cleared analysts and field-grade officers, which makes children’s data the longest-dated asset in an adversary’s portfolio and the least defended. Fifth, measure defense by the adversary’s cost to acquire. Program evaluation across data security, foreign investment review, and privacy enforcement should report the acquisition cost imposed on a hostile collector, because that figure, rather than defender spending, predicts adversary behavior. The Committee on Foreign Investment in the United States ( CFIUS ) and Federal Trade Commission children’s-privacy enforcement already generate the underlying data. Deterrence here comes from arithmetic, as it does against drones: make the cost to acquire this data exceed the influence it buys. Raising that cost is not only privacy protection, or even counterintelligence. It denies easy access to the ammunition needed for the fight over what Americans believe. Today the price runs in the opposite direction by orders of magnitude, and the adversary reads the price list as easily as we do. The cheapest weapon in the arsenal is the one aimed between our ears. A Note on Estimates and Sources Voter file figures are drawn from published state fee schedules; the national-assembly range is an inference, not an audited total. Covert collection prices are drawn from the March 2025 Justice Department indictment and from analysis of leaked contractor files. Remediation figures come from Federal Trade Commission settlement documents and Securities and Exchange Commission filings. The Cost Asymmetry Ratio framework is developed in The Cost Curve as Deterrent, with the simulator and data sources on GitHub. Disclaimer: The views expressed are the author’s own. The post Buy, Don’t Steal: The Economics of Cognitive Warfare appeared first on Small Wars Journal by Arizona State University .

title: What the US midterms mean for ties with China
zh_title: 美国中期选举对中美关系意味着什么
summary: 分析人士表示，民主党在本周的美国中期选举中取得压倒性胜利，控制了国会，这对最大竞争对手中国来说既是机遇也是挑战。 2026 年 11 月 3 日，在佐治亚州亚特兰大举行的美国中期选举之夜派对上，民主党人、亚特兰大前市长凯莎·兰斯·博顿斯 (Keisha Lance Bottoms) 预计将赢得佐治亚州州长竞选，支持者欢呼雀跃。照片：Erik S. Lesser/法新社。投票结果让民主党有能力阻止唐纳德·特朗普总统特立独行的外交政策，投票结果可能会对特朗普产生以下影响：
content:
分析人士表示，民主党在本周的美国中期选举中取得压倒性胜利，控制了国会，这对最大竞争对手中国来说既是机遇也是挑战。 2026 年 11 月 3 日，在佐治亚州亚特兰大举行的美国中期选举之夜派对上，民主党人、亚特兰大前市长凯莎·兰斯·博顿斯 (Keisha Lance Bottoms) 预计将赢得佐治亚州州长竞选，支持者欢呼雀跃。照片：Erik S. Lesser/法新社。这次投票的结果让民主党有能力阻止唐纳德·特朗普总统特立独行的外交政策，它可能会如何影响华盛顿和北京之间的棘手关系：关税会受到限制吗？分析人士表示，赢得美国国会参众两院的控制权使民主党能够限制特朗普在其任期结束后的两年内对中国产品随意征收关税。这可能对特朗普来说是一个潜在的打击，在双方达成休战协议（定于一月到期）之前，特朗普在激烈的美中贸易战中一直履行职责。上海复旦大学国际问题研究院院长吴心伯表示，如果民主党限制特朗普，这意味着他“在与中国的谈判中将更难利用关税卡”。 2026 年 5 月 14 日，中国国家主席习近平（右）和美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在北京人民大会堂会面。照片：中国外交部发言人毛宁，来自 Facebook。
然而，民主党人还必须权衡他们的行动与特朗普关税在美国企业中的受欢迎程度。新加坡南洋理工大学拉惹勒南国际研究学院高级研究员德鲁·汤普森表示，国会将“在未来两年内利用一切机会阻挠（特朗普的政策）”。但汤普森表示，民主党仍需谨慎对待进一步限制关税，这些关税“受到工会、蓝领工人和小企业的欢迎……他们历来是民主党的基础选民”。华盛顿布鲁金斯学会外交政策研究员帕特里夏·金(Patricia Kim)表示，国会将“不太愿意支持那些会急剧升级对华压力的措施，如果这样做可能会增加美国消费者和企业的成本或增加冲突的可能性”。台湾是“游戏规则改变者”？凯投宏观(Capital Economics)首席经济学家尼尔·希林(Neil Shearing)表示，台湾问题可能会“改变游戏规则”。台湾是美国支持的民主岛屿，北京声称拥有主权。华盛顿是台北最重要的安全支持者，已向台湾出售了价值数十亿美元的武器，台湾将用这些武器抵御中国潜在的攻击。但特朗普今年五月宣称美国对台军售可能成为与中国谈判的筹码，这让美国的立场受到质疑。此后，他的政府将一批价值 140 亿美元的武器推迟了数月。
台湾总统赖清德于 2026 年 2 月 11 日在台北举行的国防预算新闻发布会上发表讲话。照片：台湾总统府。希林在一份报告中写道，中国可以利用特朗普总统任期的剩余两年加大对台湾的压力，特别是如果北京“判断华盛顿心烦意乱，或者特朗普愿意同意不干预的条款”。特朗普最近赞扬了他与中国国家主席习近平的“伟大友谊”，迄今为止，他顶住了民主党人和一些共和党议员的政治压力，

【原文 English Original】
A sweeping victory for Democrats in US midterm elections this week, giving them control of Congress, presents both an opportunity and challenge for top rival China, analysts say. Supporters cheer after the announcement that Democrat Keisha Lance Bottoms, former mayor of Atlanta, is projected to win the Georgia gubernatorial race during a US midterm election night party in Atlanta, Georgia, on November 3, 2026. Photo: Erik S. Lesser/AFP. Here is how the outcome of the vote, which offers the Democratic Party the power to stymie President Donald Trump’s maverick foreign policy, could impact the thorny relationship between Washington and Beijing: Will tariffs be limited? Winning control of both houses in the US Congress puts Democrats in a position to limit Trump’s liberal use of tariffs on Chinese products in the two years he has left in office, analysts say. That could be a potential blow to Trump, who has wielded duties throughout a frenzied US-China trade war before the two sides reached a truce, set to expire in January. If Democrats limit Trump, that means he “will be less able to leverage a tariff card in negotiations with China”, said Wu Xinbo, dean at the Institute of International Studies at Fudan University in Shanghai. China’s President Xi Jinping (right) and US President Donald Trump at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing on May 14, 2026. Photo: Mao Ning Chinese Foreign Ministry Spokesperson, via Facebook. However, Democrats will also have to weigh their actions against the popularity of Trump’s tariffs among US businesses. Congress will “take every opportunity to thwart (Trump’s policies) over the next two years”, said Drew Thompson, a senior fellow at the S. Rajaratnam School of International Studies at Singapore’s Nanyang Technological University. But Democrats will still have to tread carefully on further restricting tariffs that “are popular with unions, blue-collar workers and small businesses… who have historically been a base constituency for the Democrats”, Thompson said. Congress will be “less inclined to support measures that would sharply escalate pressure on China if doing so risks raising costs for American consumers and businesses or increasing the likelihood of conflict”, said Patricia Kim, a foreign policy fellow at the Brookings Institution in Washington. Taiwan a ‘game changer’? The issue of Taiwan, the US-backed democratic island claimed by Beijing, could be a “game changer”, said Neil Shearing, group chief economist at Capital Economics. Washington is Taipei’s most important security backer and has sold billions of dollars’ worth of arms to Taiwan that the island would use to fend off a potential Chinese attack. But Trump threw the US stance into question in May when he declared that US arms sales to Taiwan could be a bargaining chip in talks with China. His administration has since delayed for months a $14-billion batch of weapons . Taiwan President Lai Ching-te speaks during a press conference on the defence budget in Taipei on February 11, 2026. Photo: Taiwan’s Office of the President. China could use the remaining two years of Trump’s presidency to increase pressure on Taiwan, particularly if Beijing “judges that Washington is distracted or that Trump would be willing to agree terms to not intervene”, Shearing wrote in a note. Trump, who recently hailed his “great friendship” with China’s President Xi Jinping, has so far resisted political pressure from Democrats — and some Republican lawmakers — to greenlight the arms package. But a Democrat-controlled Congress “may force Trump to resume arms sales to Taiwan next year”, Wu said. “If that happens, that will also undermine the stability of US-China relationship.” Alternatively, for China, renewed support of Taipei from the US Congress may be “a stronger incentive for (Beijing) to play it safer with Taiwan”, said Steve Tsang, director of the SOAS China Institute. Nevertheless, Thompson pointed out, while Congress can pass bills requiring Trump to approve an arms sale, the president retains the power to veto it “or simply ignore it”. Will Beijing treat Trump as a lame duck? From China’s perspective, even though Trump has been politically weakened by the midterms, Beijing is unlikely to change its strategy towards working with him, analysts say. “Beijing is likely to continue cultivating him through high-profile, leader-to-leader engagement with Xi Jinping, viewing this as the least costly way to manage relations with Washington,” said Kim. “Neither Beijing nor Washington appears to expect or seek a fundamental improvement in bilateral relations,” she added. Tsang of the SOAS China Institute said “Trump being relegated to lame-duck status will be used by the Chinese to put more pressure on him”. But, he added, Beijing is “calculating” and “would not want to push too hard and trigger Trump behaving totally irresponsibly”.

title: EXCLUSIVE INTERVIEW – Rep. Randy Fine Sounds Alarm On China’s Influence Over Iran, Threats To U.S. Technology
zh_title: 独家采访——众议员兰迪·法恩对中国对伊朗的影响以及对美国技术的威胁​​发出警告
summary: 佛罗里达州共和党众议员兰迪·法恩对中国对伊朗日益增长的影响力表示担忧，特别是考虑到今年年初开始的伊朗持续冲突。在国会山，法恩向 Gateway Pundit 记者 Alicia Powe 和我谈论了伊朗战争期间的美中关系。 “你不会解决与中国的所有问题。这是一种持续的关系，”法恩告诉我们。 “对我来说，我最关心的问题是贸易、技术盗窃，以及显然它们对伊朗的影响并使冲突发酵。” “你永远无法解决与中国的所有问题。
content:
佛罗里达州共和党众议员兰迪·法恩对中国对伊朗日益增长的影响力表示担忧，特别是考虑到今年年初开始的伊朗持续冲突。在国会山，法恩向 Gateway Pundit 记者 Alicia Powe 和我谈论了伊朗战争期间的美中关系。 “你不会解决与中国的所有问题。这是一种持续的关系，”法恩告诉我们。 “对我来说，我最关心的问题是贸易、技术盗窃，以及显然它们对伊朗的影响并使冲突发酵。” “你永远无法解决与中国的所有问题。这是一种持续的关系。” @RepFine 担心中国对伊朗的所谓影响。 @gatewaypundit https://t.co/uvRiBKhbmF — Myles Morell (@MorellMedia) 2026 年 11 月 8 日 中国和伊朗彼此有着密切的经济关系。鉴于与伊朗的持续冲突以及中国想要超越美国成为最强大国家的愿望，法恩的担忧是最不值得倾听的。中国也可能是伊朗获取核武器努力的幕后黑手，许多共和党人认为这就是我们目前与伊朗交战以阻止这种情况发生的原因。特朗普总统今年已两次会见中国国家主席习近平，以加强关系，特朗普曾访问北京，梅和习近平则于九月访问白宫。白宫的会议似乎进行得很顺利，特朗普总统在被问及此事时甚至给了12/10的评分。
习近平主席和中国共产党的支持表明了他们对双方的团结和支持。@gatewaypundit https://t.co/DMDaLTQW7f — Myles Morell (@MorellMedia) 2026 年 9 月 26 日 习近平主席和中国共产党可能指望伊朗冲突削弱美国，这将在他们争夺全球经济霸权的竞赛中获得重大推动力。中国对伊朗的外国影响是不容忽视的，特别是考虑到战争的升级以及中国正在与美国进行的科技军备竞赛。赢得人工智能军备竞赛的国家最终将成为最强大的国家，法恩对中国可能窃取美国技术以获得领先地位提出了严厉警告。独家专访——众议员兰迪·法恩对中国对伊朗的影响和对美国技术的威胁​​发出警报，该文章首先出现在 The Gateway Pundit 上。

Rep. Randy Fine, R-FL, expressed concerns over China’s growing influence on Iran, especially now given the ongoing conflict there, which started early this year. On Capitol Hill, Fine spoke to Gateway Pundit reporter Alicia Powe and me about U.S.-China relations amid the war in Iran. “You’re not gonna resolve everything with China. That’s an ongoing relationship,” Fine told us. “The issues to me that I’m most concerned about are sort of trade, technology theft, and obviously their influence over Iran and bringing that conflict in ferment.” “You’re never gonna resolve everything with China. That’s an ongoing relationship.” @RepFine is concerned about China’s alleged influence on Iran. @gatewaypundit https://t.co/uvRiBKhbmF — Myles Morell (@MorellMedia) November 8, 2026 China and Iran have a close economic relationship with one another. Given the ongoing conflict against Iran and China’s desire to overtake the U.S. as the most powerful nation, Fine’s concerns are worst listening to. China could also be behind Iran’s efforts to acquire a nuclear weapon, which many Republicans argue is the reason why we are currently at war with Iran to stop this from happening. President Trump has met with Chinese President Xi twice this year in an effort to strengthen relations, as Trump traveled to Beijing back and May and Xi came to the White House in September. The meeting at the White House seemingly went well, with President Trump even rating it a 12/10 when he was asked about it. Supports of President Xi and the Chinese Communist Party show their solidarity and support for both. @gatewaypundit https://t.co/DMDaLTQW7f — Myles Morell (@MorellMedia) September 26, 2026 President Xi and the CCP might be banking on the Iran conflict weakening the U.S., which would give them a major boost in the race for global economic hegemony. China’s foreign influence on Iran is something that cannot be ignored, especially given the war’s escalation and a tech arms race that China is waging against the U.S. The country that wins the AI arms race will ultimately become the most powerful country and Fine gave a strict warning on China potentially stealing U.S. technology to get ahead. Fundraiser by David Xia : Fighting for legal fairness
David Xia and 2 others are organizing this fundraiser.
Supporting Yeliang Xia with donation for legal defence against the evil fugitive billionaire Wengui Guo (most wanted by Interpol)
Mr. Yeliang Xia, a former professor at Peking University and a political dissident from China.
Mr. Xia has been sued for his inquiries and criticism through TV and twitter on Guo’s so-called exposure of top confidential information in China by Wengui Guo (aka Miles Kwok, a notorious Chinese billionaire and fugitive escaped from China in 2015 and Guo got RED NOTICE twice from INTERPOL) at Eastern District Court of Virginia.
Guo hired a gang of cyber accessories and made up tons of rumors to smear Mr. Xia and Xia’s family members while filing a complaint against Xia with an accusation of defamation and a claim of five million US $ for compensation.
Guo has been abusing legal resources in US with more than 41 lawsuits for defamation undergoing and he claimed that he planned to sue more than 91 persons for the accusation of defamation.
Mr. Xia and many other defendants can’t afford to hire a qualified and experienced attorney to defend themselves. Thus, with suggestions by many web bystanders, Xia started a campaign to collect donation for legal fees against Guo.
Xia will use those donations only for the purpose of the lawsuit and he has been supported by several volunteers to work on collection, bookkeeping and supervision of donations. The goal has been set to 100,000 US$, and an individual account of GoFundMe was set up as a major channel for donation.
Please contact Julia Lee and other volunteers through [email redacted] for the details.
We’re most grateful to your attention, encouragement, support and great help!
原北大教授、政治异议人士，现时政/财经新闻评论人夏业良先生（美国之音/自由亚洲电台/博讯/新唐人等媒体）因网络质疑和评论，而被中国逃亡商人郭文贵花钱组织围攻/抹黑，并在美国弗吉尼亚东区联邦法院提交所谓诽谤指控和滥诉。
夏先生通过电视节目和推特对郭的所谓爆料（包括最高机密信息）进行了质疑和批评，郭雇佣组织了对夏及其家人的网络围攻，同时指控夏对他进行诽谤并索赔五百万美元。
郭滥用美国司法资源， 目前正在进行中的诉讼超过41起，郭宣称他计划起诉至少91位对他进行诽谤的个人。
夏先生和其他被告均无力承担雇佣合格并有经验的律师之花费。因此在众多网络旁观者的建议下开始了募捐应对郭之诉讼的律师费用。
夏先生将把募捐得款只用于本案诉讼之中，并且得到若干志愿者的支持和帮助，他们协助收集募捐款项/记账与募捐监督等工作。本次募捐活动的目标已设定为十万美元，并且已经开设了一个名为“GoFundMe”之软件的募捐账户平台以作为主要募捐渠道。
请各位捐助者通过电子邮箱：[email redacted] 与Julia Lee等志愿者联系，以获得相关细节。

民眾黨竹北市長參選人邱臣遠（左）8日晚間舉辦造勢晚會，黨主席黃國昌（右）、創黨主席柯文哲（中）等人站台。（邱臣遠競選辦公室提供）中央社記者魯鋼駿傳真 115年11月8日
（中央社記者魯鋼駿新竹縣8日電）民眾黨竹北市長參選人邱臣遠今天晚間在新竹縣政府前方封街舉辦造勢晚會，民眾黨主席黃國昌、創黨主席柯文哲等人站台，國民黨籍台北市長蔣萬安則錄影打氣，邱臣遠呼籲選民投票支持。
邱臣遠競選辦公室發布新聞稿表示，這場「全台挺臣遠 民眾大集結」造勢晚會以演唱會形式舉行，新竹市長高虹安、中廣前董事長趙少康、民眾黨立委及各地議員參選人等人出席，蔣萬安、國民黨立法院黨團則以預錄影片方式加油打氣。
蔣萬安透過預錄影片指出，邱臣遠過去與他是立院好同事，是非常認真、負責用心，而且願意做事的人，相信過去累積的經驗一定可以帶到竹北，讓竹北越來越好。
黃國昌致詞表示，今天造勢活動象徵民眾黨吹響反攻號角，民眾黨對邱臣遠深具信心，認為他具有經驗與執行力，能帶領竹北向前發展。
黃國昌指出，民眾黨做事的風格就是說到做到，對於該有的堅持，也會堅持到底。竹北選戰象徵台灣第三勢力能否走出自己的道路，盼選民跨越黨派藩籬，選出最適合的市長。
柯文哲致詞表示，竹北受惠於新竹科學園區發展，吸引大量人口移入，但快速發展也帶來交通、學校教室不足、托嬰托幼及長照等問題，需要完整的城市治理規劃。
柯文哲指出，邱臣遠曾任立法委員、民眾黨立法院黨團總召，卸任後擔任新竹市副市長、代理市長，具有中央與地方、行政與立法經驗，也熟悉黨務工作，是善良正直、認真做事的人。
柯文哲表示，邱臣遠提出「雙城共榮、科技治理、幸福宜居」3項主張，符合民眾黨的理念，新竹市與竹北市必須連動發展，並運用科技治理改善市民生活。
邱臣遠致詞說，過去半年走遍竹北，持續與市民互動，他提出5大幸福城市藍圖，未來將推動托育、育兒及通學步道等市政工作，若市民願意將責任交給他，就會把百分之百的自己交給竹北。（編輯：張國政）1151108

content:
印尼女子因争吵从大角咀人行天桥跳下入院中国劳工公告栏
2026 年 11 月 9 日星期一 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
印尼女子因争吵从大角咀行人天桥跳下入院
周日凌晨，一名32岁印尼女子与男友争吵后从大角咀人行天桥跳下入院。她被发现意识清醒并被送往伊丽莎白女王医院。该女子持有香港身份证。
据警方称，周日凌晨，一名 32 岁印度尼西亚女子与男友发生激烈争吵，从大角咀人行天桥跳下，被送往医院。
事件发生在樱桃街公园附近。早上6点左右，警方接到该女子男友的电话。他告诉当局，在一场争吵中，这名女子似乎情绪激动，从人行天桥上跳了下来。
警察发现该女子倒在地上。她意识清醒，随后被送往伊利沙伯医院接受治疗。
据了解，该女子为香港身份证持有人。

Monday, 9 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Indonesian woman jumps from Tai Kok Tsui footbridge after quarrel, hospitalised
A 32-year-old Indonesian woman was hospitalised after jumping from a footbridge in Tai Kok Tsui early on Sunday following a quarrel with her boyfriend. She was found conscious and taken to Queen Elizabeth Hospital. The woman holds a Hong Kong identity card.
A 32-year-old Indonesian woman was hospitalised in the early hours of Sunday after jumping from a footbridge in Tai Kok Tsui, following a heated argument with her boyfriend, according to police.
The incident occurred near Cherry Street Park. Police received a call from the woman's boyfriend at around 6am. He told authorities that during an argument, the woman—who appeared to be in an emotional state—leapt off the footbridge.
Police officers found the woman lying on the ground. She was conscious and was subsequently sent to Queen Elizabeth Hospital for medical treatment.
It is understood that the woman is a Hong Kong identity card holder.

巴基斯坦的人工智能战争
2026 年美国中期选举：对澳大利亚的影响
10月，在海峡两岸颇受欢迎的台湾知名电视主持人蔡康永被媒体拍到出席竞选台北市市长的立委沉彪马的竞选活动。鉴于蔡英文在中国的受欢迎程度，他的出现很快引发了批评。现任台北市市长蒋万安邀请蔡英文参加他自己的竞选总部的落成典礼，从而化解了争议。在参加沉的竞选活动三周后，蔡英文公开表示，他从未支持台独，他的工作需要他与持有不同政治观点的人互动。第二天，他参加了蒋介石的竞选活动。
如果参加集会就等于宣布支持台湾的未来，想象一下11月28日的投票结果会如何。
执政的民进党候选人沉多年来一直在研究中国的影响力运作并促进台湾的平民准备。中国当局已以分裂国家罪名对他展开调查。国民党现任总统蒋介石在台北和上海的官员之间保持着开放的沟通渠道。北京和华盛顿可能会倾向于将沈氏的胜利解读为对独立的投票，或者将蒋介石的胜利解读为转向中国。然而，无论哪种解释都会将市政选举与台北选民未被要求投票的问题联系起来。
考虑一下沉和蒋 10 月 31 日辩论期间的一次交流。蒋要求沉解释为什么两个重建项目（一个在大同，另一个在内湖）陷入停滞。蒋将延误归因于台北松山机场附近建筑高度的限制。沉先生反驳了自己的问题：如果市政府官员知道这些限制，为什么他们不从一开始就向居民解释呢？蒋介石利用这次交流质疑他的挑战者对城市事务的指挥。反过来，沉用它来询问居民，如果他们发现障碍来得太晚而无法采取任何行动，那么专业知识对他们有什么好处。
然而，从他们激烈的交流中得到的最重要的收获不是候选人所说的话，而是他们没有说的话。中国这个两岸关系中的大象，在两个小时的辩论中一次也没有被作为关键问题提出。
这概括了台北选民实际做出决定时所依据的当地问题。有些人可能会投票给蒋，认为他推动了其他困难项目的进展，其中包括南机场夜市的一个项目。其他人可能会赞成沉的建议，即对旧建筑进行地震风险筛查并帮助居民安排维修。两个房主可以投票给不同的坦率

Taipei’s Voters Aren’t Choosing Independence or Unification – The Diplomat
Taipei’s Voters Aren’t Choosing Independence or Unification

North Korea’s State of Play in the Russia-Ukraine War
China’s Companionship Economy: Paying for Someone to Play With Me
Is India Extending Its Control Over Islamic Practice In Kashmir?
Will New Laws Finally End Human Rights Abuses in Asia’s Factories?
