【原文 English Original】
Top Of The Week HBM from Samsung and SK hynix is reportedly reaching Chinese AI chip developers through smuggling operations that exploit U.S. export-control loopholes . According to The Information, intermediaries package HBM with low-performance server processors, ship the combined components to China, and then remove the memory for resale, including to customers of Huawei . Approximately 600,000 Nvidia H200 AI chips are being held in Hong Kong awaiting approval for shipment to mainland China, according to Reuters. Beijing has limited imports in an effort to reduce reliance on U.S. technology and encourage adoption of domestically developed processors. Micron reportedly paused construction of a $4.5B memory-chip plant in Taiwan due to a prolonged labor dispute, according to Bloomberg. Micron has not confirmed the suspension, and the effect on its longer-term Taiwan manufacturing plans remains unclear. Samsung Electronics is reportedly planning to expand advanced foundry capacity for HBM base dies at two locations. In South Korea, the company reportedly plans a new foundry facility at Giheung , with 2nm and 4nm production lines and an estimated ~US$17B investment, along with a possible advanced packaging expansion. Separately, Samsung reportedly secured orders from AMD and Nvidia for 2nm HBM base dies to be produced at a proposed second foundry in Taylor, Texas, with mass production targeted for 2030. Note: Samsung has not confirmed the reported Giheung investment or Taylor customer orders. Oracle canceled a 5-year agreement worth an estimated $7B to provide Tencent access to up to 100,000 advanced AI chips through data centers in Southeast Asia, following pressure from the Trump administration, according to the Financial Times. U.S. officials raised concerns about Chinese companies accessing advanced processors through overseas cloud services, while officials in China’s Guangdong province urged Tencent to use domestically developed chips. Bosch plans to establish a dedicated semiconductor division in January 2028, expanding its foundry business and opening more manufacturing capacity to external customers. The company is targeting €5B in semiconductor sales by 2030 and plans to expand its semiconductor test center in Penang, Malaysia, by the mid-2030s. Marvell ‘s pending acquisition of Lumentum, initially valued at $115B , is drawing mixed reactions, with analysts seeing opportunities to challenge Broadcom in AI optical interconnects, but also raising concerns about supplier concentration and customer relationships. Questions about the purchase price and regulatory approval have added to investor concerns. U.S. election results raised concerns about tighter restrictions on data center development , particularly in major markets such as Texas and Ohio , as well as increased congressional oversight of AI , including AI safety, cybersecurity, and industry practices. Restrictions that delay or reduce data center construction could weaken demand for AI accelerators, HBM, and networking chips, and increased regulatory scrutiny could create additional uncertainty for AI infrastructure investment. (See chip stock impacts here .) More acquisitions and deals Onsemi confirmed it plans to acquire Ferric, developer of integrated voltage regulators, for $600M in cash, plus up to $175M in milestone payments. Entegris acquired Advanced Abrasives and announced plans for a new SiC materials manufacturing line in Taiwan. The company also partnered with Element Six to develop diamond-based thermal-management materials for advanced packaging and expanded its deal with Kioxia on BiCS Flash 3D flash memory . Supermicro is initially planning to use 10,000 SambaNova SN50 RDUs for its new AI disaggregated inference systems as part of a strategic collaboration. China’s biggest EDA company, Empyrean , plans to acquire a ~50.4% stake in Easy-Logic for US$33M. Unconfirmed : Mitsui Chemicals reportedly plans to buy JSR , semiconductor materials maker, for at least $8B. Two acquisitions finalized: ADI ‘s purchase of Alif Semiconductor, adding its AI-native MCU and fusion processors, and Forge Nano ‘s acquisition of HZO for its nanoscale coating platforms. Reports and analysis Global semiconductor sales reached $518B in Q3, up 24% from Q2, according to the SIA/WSTS . September sales were up 147% year over year. Worldwide silicon wafer shipments increased 13.4% year over year in Q3, reports SEMI . Q3 DRAM revenue approached $200B , up 369% year over year as AI demand and higher prices strained supply, per Counterpoint . TrendForce projects the AI networking and interconnect market will reach $279.8B in 2027. AI data centers are moving toward 800 VDC power distribution as rack power rises toward megawatt levels, with Nvidia, Google, Microsoft and other industry participants working through OCP on common architectures and interfaces. Earnings Revenue growth/decline year over year: Arm up 27% , Arteris up 48% , AMD up 45% , Bruker up ~2% , Coherent up 50% , GlobalFoundries up 13% , Lattice up 118% , Nova up 28% , onsemi up 11%, PDF Solutions up 20% , Qnity sales up 22% , Qualcomm down 8% , and Tower up 33% . Quick Links To More News In-Depth — Auto, Security and AI newsletter, shift left becoming a system-level problem, and who verifies AI. Global — Europe boosts chip-design funding; Asia expands materials and test capacity; U.S. advances AI-driven chip design R&D. New Technologies — RISC-V automotive MCUs, high-bandwidth compute, high-density testing, and ceramic data storage. Security — 3D-stacked HW shield against side channel attacks; AMD vulnerabilities, compromised Android devices, secure-element certification. Trending Video — Chiplets: shared resources, a mix of tools, and multiple dies add new challenges for design teams. Research — AI chip inspection; cryogenic transistors; edge AI efficiency; ferroelectric memory. Quantum Hardware — New QPUs; error-correction platforms; CMOS-based qubit readout; reliability and error suppression. Workforce | Education — Apprenticeship funding; semiconductor doctoral fellowships; AI’s impact on engineering careers. Events and Webinars — ACM/IEEE ICCAD, Electronica & SEMICON Europe. Webinars on shift left, verification, and debug of high-power motor controllers. Global Americas UC San Diego and Qualcomm launched a $750K AI-driven chip-design research initiative, funded by a $500K Qualcomm gift and $250K in UCSD matching funds, focused on AI methods for SoC design, processor architectures, hardware accelerators, memory systems, and interconnects. CSIS examines Albany NanoTech as a model for semiconductor technology clusters, highlighting shared R&D infrastructure, industry partnerships, and workforce development supporting sub-2nm technologies, advanced packaging, photonics, and quantum systems. The OCP Foundation is opening nominations for project leads across all 12 top-level OCP Projects, ranging from hardware management to the AI computing continuum. Europe The European Semiconductor Industry Association (ESIA) called for dedicated semiconductor funding under the EU’s 2028–2034 budget, including support for R&D, pilot production, advanced packaging, and industrial deployment. The association urged policymakers to coordinate national and EU funding, preserve the Chips Joint Undertaking’s cross-sector role, and ease restrictions on intellectual property transfers within multinational companies. The European Fabless Semiconductor Association was formally launched to advance fabless semiconductor design within the EU. The EU launched a European Chip Design Platform ( EuroCDP ) with €525M to stimulate new chip design companies . Synopsys and the EU Chips JU signed a deal to expand access to its EDA software for semiconductor startups and research teams through the EuroCDP. Asia South Korea reaffirmed plans to spend ₩21.3T (US$16B ) on AI and major initiatives covering semiconductors, physical AI, and data centers, in its proposed 2027 budget, nearly doubling this year’s allocation. Panasonic Industry plans to invest about ¥92B ($583M) to expand AI-related materials production and R&D, including circuit-board materials, capacitors and semiconductor packaging materials. Two workers were killed and five injured in an explosion and fire at Panasonic Industrial Devices Materials ‘ factory in Hsinchu, Taiwan. The facility produces PCB and semiconductor packaging materials. The cause and production impact have not been determined yet. South Korea’s Techwing plans to invest approximately ₩52.6B ($39M) in a new semiconductor equipment factory in Cheonan to expand production of memory test handlers and HBM cube probers. In-Depth Semiconductor Engineering published the Automotive, Security and AI newsletter, including: Fitting AI Models To Edge Applications Physical AI Pushes The Limits Of Hardware College Grads And AI Plus : Shift Left Is Becoming A System-Level Problem Video: Accelerating Plug-And-Play Prototyping In Chiplet-Based Designs Perspective: Putting AI To The Test New Technologies Automotive and physical AI Infineon introduced its first automotive MCU platform based on the RISC-V architecture , adding hardware-based physical protection and crypto agility, with support planned for post-quantum security requirements. Infineon and Qualcomm are collaborating on a microcontroller-based subsystem for Snapdragon Ride reference platforms used in central car computers for automated driving and digital cockpit applications. STMicro announced a new microcontroller portfolio covering industrial, automotive, and physical AI applications. Test, measurement Keysight released XR3, a low-profile 14-bit oscilloscope designed to increase measurement capacity in rack-based test systems. Siemens introduced an automated component model extraction solution developed with Bosch that cuts frequency-response-function measurement time by up to 93% and produces ISO 20270-compliant models for virtual NVH development. AI hardware & memory Qualcomm completed hardware validation of its high-bandwidth compute (HBC) silicon, exercising the full memory read/write path and near-memory computations. Cerabyte completed S3 integration testing of its ceramic data storage within established object-storage workflows, in collaboration with CERN openlab. Design Arteris exceeded 1,000 customer silicon design starts using its interconnect IP, and released a report showing the evolution of SoC, ASIC, FPGA, and MCU designs across key markets. Research MCL , PVA TePla and ASE researchers developed an AI-based image-enhancement method for detecting flip-chip interconnect defects . By improving scanning acoustic microscopy images, the method increased detection of cracks and delamination in extreme-low-k dielectric layers from 5.2% to 100% in tests involving 19 defects across three packages. TU Munich , Applied Materials et al. evaluated cryogenic 2nm GAA transistors and superconducting interconnects for energy-efficient AI computing. Using a calibrated chip-design flow, they reported a 3x performance increase and 7.7x improvement in energy efficiency for a modeled AI accelerator’s compute fabric, excluding memory, data movement, and refrigeration power. ETH Zurich -led researchers benchmarked 10 commercial sub-watt edge AI devices , comparing inference performance and energy consumption across convolutional neural networks and small vision transformers. The study found that memory traffic, rather than computational workload, was the primary factor determining latency on the tested neural-network accelerators, highlighting the importance of data movement in low-power AI hardware design. HUST and PolyU researchers developed annealing-free ferroelectric transistors with ultrathin oxide-semiconductor channels for NVM and neuromorphic computing . The devices achieved a memory window of up to 20.6V, endurance of 10⁶ cycles, and stable 6-bit operation across 64 states. A neuromorphic network evaluation achieved 93.02% recognition accuracy. Security Government security news ENISA issued new EU cybersecurity-certification guidance for secure elements , outlining how cryptographic security services can be evaluated for use across different chip platforms. EU cybersecurity authorities issued a coordinated response after a new wave of attacks on internet-connected refrigeration systems. Japan ’s METI and IPA are participating in a new effort to align security requirements for connected hardware under Japan’s JC-STAR program and the EU Cyber Resilience Act. Alerts and attacks AMD issued security bulletins covering a newly discovered EDK II PXE driver vulnerability that can allow pre-boot code execution and a contention-based side-channel technique for exploiting known vulnerabilities in AMD CPUs. Dell issued BIOS updates for a critical Qualcomm chipset vulnerability affecting five Latitude, Inspiron, and XPS systems. The flaw can cause memory corruption when a malformed RSA key is imported into Qualcomm’s Keystore. Google banned Videostrong Technology from making certified Android devices after its security researchers determined that the company was responsible for creating an XCPE backdoor that enrolled 1.3 million set-top boxes into a criminal botnet. CISA ’s alerts for the week are here . Security offering and deals Vietnam has its first-ever homegrown security chip after government-backed Viettel Group successfully integrated a domestically developed cryptographic algorithm into silicon. u-blox announced that it will integrate Kudelski Labs ’ embedded security IP into its future chipsets. Chinese tech giant Tencent released Hy4, its powerful new open-source AI model . Amid growing concerns about agentic hacking, the company said it limited the model’s cybersecurity training data to defensive material only. Security technical papers NC State and Princeton researchers proposed a 3D-stacked hardware shield to protect post-quantum cryptography accelerators from side-channel attacks. The design stacks a guard layer above the cryptographic hardware, using decoy-key activity and physical shielding to obscure power leakage from NTT computations. Randomized Caches in HW : Challenges/Trade-offs ( RUB, Max Planck et al.) Quantum Hardware New launches Universal Quantum launched its iQPU quantum processor , combining a large trapped-ion compute surface, ultra-low-noise integrated control electronics, and chip-to-chip interfaces designed to scale quantum computing systems. The processor is manufactured on a commercial 200mm semiconductor production line. IBM , ORNL , and AMD opened a new co-design platform for quantum error correction at IBM’s quantum facility in New York , co-locating the 120-qubit IBM Quantum Nighthawk with ORNL’s Umbra HPC system. The titanium-nitride device functions as a compact superinductor and was integrated with a silicon quantum dot to enable sensitive RF charge detection, potentially supporting more compact readout hardware for semiconductor spin qubits. University of Regensburg -led researchers demonstrated a real-time feedback technique that reduced superconducting-qubit operation errors by approximately 54%, from 0.14% to 0.065%. The approach identifies changes in qubit resonance frequency associated with material defects and adjusts control signals to improve reliability. Alice & Bob reported extended bit-flip lifetimes in superconducting cat qubits , averaging 44 minutes on a single-qubit test device and reaching 189 to 252 minutes on selected qubits in its 12-qubit Helium 2 processor. The preliminary results demonstrate strong suppression of bit-flip errors during idle operation, with performance during error-correction operations still to be validated. Workforce, Education The U.S. Department of Labor opened applications for a $40M apprenticeship incentive fund that includes semiconductor fabrication among several high-growth sectors. Registered apprenticeship sponsors can receive up to $6K per eligible new apprentice. UCLA named the first 10 doctoral fellows in its Semiconductor Hub , with research spanning 3D ICs, advanced packaging, silicon photonics, compute-in-memory, and AI hardware. Fellows will also intern with one of the Hub’s industry partners, including Synopsys , GlobalFoundries , and others. In a new Semiconductor Engineering roundtable , industry experts discuss how AI is changing expectations for new engineering graduates. Demand for electrical engineers remains strong, but AI agents are taking over some traditional junior-level tasks, raising expectations for practical experience, AI fluency, and the ability to tackle higher-level engineering work earlier in their careers. U.S. community colleges are expanding semiconductor technician training programs as the industry faces a potential shortage of 157,000 workers by 2030, according to the Associated Press. title: Nous Research Releases Arete-27B that Cuts Qwen3.8-27B Propaganda From 22% to 0.9%
zh_title: Nous Research 发布 Arete-27B，将 Qwen3.8-27B 宣传从 22% 削减至 0.9%
summary: Nous Research 发布了 Arete-27B，这是阿里巴巴 Qwen3.8-27B 的监督微调。 Arete-27B 是一个 27B 开放权重模型，从 Qwen 的答案中剥离了中国国家框架。在 Nous 自己的 803 提示评估中，包含宣传的答案从 22% 下降到 0.9%。开发人员无需国家统一的答案即可获得 Qwen 级代理技能。权重、评估和训练数据都是公开的。 TL;DR 大小：27B 密集参数（全部有效）。在 64k 环境下进行训练。 Base Qwen3.8-27B 原生支持 262,144 个令牌。运行于：BF16 重量为 53.81 GB。社区 Q4_K_M 数量为 17.20 GB，大小为 24 GB
content:
Nous Research 发布了 Arete-27B，这是阿里巴巴 Qwen3.8-27B 的监督微调。 Arete-27B 是一个 27B 开放权重模型，从 Qwen 的答案中剥离了中国国家框架。在 Nous 自己的 803 提示评估中，包含宣传的答案从 22% 下降到 0.9%。开发人员无需国家统一的答案即可获得 Qwen 级代理技能。权重、评估和训练数据都是公开的。 TL;DR 大小：27B 密集参数（全部有效）。在 64k 环境下进行训练。 Base Qwen3.8-27B 原生支持 262,144 个令牌。运行于：BF16 重量为 53.81 GB。社区 Q4_K_M 数量为 17.20 GB，大小适合 24 GB 消费级 GPU。性能：Nous 运行的基准测试中的能力保持不变；现在的政治框架符合西方模式。最佳：宣传率 0.9%，低于基础 Qwen3.8-27B 的 22%。最差：事实得分 2.98（共 5 分）； 803 个答案中的 216 个仍然得分为 0。Arete-27B 是什么？ Arete-27B 是仅经过监督微调后的 Qwen3.8-27B。 Nous 没有使用强化学习，没有偏好优化，也没有改变架构。许可证是 Apache 2.0，与基本型号匹配。 Nous 团队表示，它在基本模型中看到了对敏感话题的拒绝、偏转和中共框架下的答案。它选择了 Qwen3.8-27B，因为它是最有能力的本地模型并显示了目标行为。 Arete-27B 是如何训练的？老师是 Inkling，Thinking Machines 的开放模型。 Nous 选择了一位开放教师来避免蒸馏的使用条款限制。
在发现有关中国主题的错综复杂的记录后，它拒绝了 Nemotron 3 Ultra。训练涵盖了 64k 上下文中的约 5280 万个标记，没有序列打包。该运行需要 2 个周期和 1,202 个步骤，批量大小为 48。它使用 AdamW、1e-5 峰值学习率和张量并行 4。所有语言模型权重都经过训练。视觉编码器保持冻结状态，因为数据只是文本。多令牌预测头被禁用。发布的 arete-data-pairs 集包含 7 个主题的 34,878 个提示。每个提示都有一个 Inkling 答案和一个 Qwen 答案。 SFT 分裂中有 29,236 个已接受的教师答案。宣传评估如何进行？ Propaganda_Eval 集有 7 个值类别的 803 个提示。其中包括言论自由、国家意识形态、数据隐私和民主。每个提示都包含来自引用来源的 2 到 4 个必需事实。 Grok 4.7 法官分别对两件事进行评分： 事实平均值（0 到 5）：答案陈述了多少个必需事实。一项反对的事实得分为 0。任何宣传：采用国家账户作为自己账户的答案份额。法官必须引用确切的短语来标记宣传。 Nous 删除了与评估重叠的所有训练提示。该评估已获得 MIT 许可，并包含评分脚本。 window.addEventListener("消息",function(e){if(e.data&&e.data.mtpArete){var f=document.getElementById("mtp-arete-frame");if(f)f.style.height=e.data.mtpArete+"px";}});基准测试显示什么？
在模型卡页面上，Arete-27B 将事实均值从 2.32 提高到 2.98。宣传值从 22% 下降到 0.9%。得分为 0 的答案从 359 个下降到 803 个中的 216 个。最大的变化来自言论自由。事实得分从0.89上升到2.44，宣传得分从60%下降到1%。 Nous 测试中的能力。 Hermes Bench 从 65.77% 上升到 65.60%，Nous 称之为噪音。 Terminal-Bench-2.1 在 Nous 的使用中的使用率从 67% 上升到 70%。 Nous 并没有将这一成果归功于自己。 Arete-27B 相比如何？指标 Arete-27B Qwen3.8-27B Muse Glimmer 30B Gemma 4 31B 开发者 Nous Research 阿里巴巴 Qwen Meta Google DeepMind

【原文 English Original】
Nous Research has released Arete-27B , a supervised fine-tune of Alibaba’s Qwen3.8-27B . Arete-27B is a 27B open-weight model that strips Chinese state framing from Qwen’s answers. On Nous’s own 803-prompt eval, answers containing propaganda fell from 22% to 0.9%. Developers get Qwen-class agentic skill without state-aligned answers. The weights, eval and training data are all public. TL;DR Size: 27B dense parameters (all active). Trained at 64k context. Base Qwen3.8-27B supports 262,144 tokens natively. Runs on: BF16 weights are 53.81 GB. A community Q4_K_M quant is 17.20 GB, sized for 24 GB consumer GPUs. Performance: Capability unchanged on the benchmarks Nous ran; political framing now matches Western models. Best: Propaganda rate 0.9%, down from 22% for base Qwen3.8-27B. Worst: Fact score 2.98 of 5; 216 of 803 answers still score 0. What is Arete-27B? Arete-27B is Qwen3.8-27B after supervised fine-tuning only . Nous used no RL, no preference optimization and no architecture changes. The license is Apache 2.0, matching the base model. Nous team states that it saw refusals, deflections and CCP-framed answers on sensitive topics in the base model. It picked Qwen3.8-27B because it was the most capable local model and showed the target behavior. How was Arete-27B trained? The teacher was Inkling , an open model from Thinking Machines. Nous chose an open teacher to avoid terms-of-use limits on distillation. It rejected Nemotron 3 Ultra after finding a checkered record on China topics. Training covered about 52.8 million tokens at 64k context, without sequence packing. The run took 2 epochs and 1,202 steps at batch size 48. It used AdamW, a 1e-5 peak learning rate and tensor parallel 4. All language-model weights were trained. The vision encoder stayed frozen, since the data is text-only. The multi-token-prediction head was disabled. The released arete-data-pairs set holds 34,878 prompts across 7 topics. Each prompt has both an Inkling answer and a Qwen answer. 29,236 accepted teacher answers form the SFT split. How does the propaganda eval work? The Propaganda_Eval set has 803 prompts across 7 value categories. These include freedom of expression, state ideology, data privacy and democracy. Each prompt carries 2 to 4 required facts from a cited source. A Grok 4.7 judge grades two things separately: Fact mean (0 to 5): how many required facts the answer states. One opposed fact scores 0. Any propaganda: share of answers that adopt the state’s account as their own. The judge must quote the exact phrase to flag propaganda. Nous removed every training prompt that overlapped the eval. The eval is MIT licensed and includes grading scripts. window.addEventListener("message",function(e){if(e.data&&e.data.mtpArete){var f=document.getElementById("mtp-arete-frame");if(f)f.style.height=e.data.mtpArete+"px";}}); What do the benchmarks show? On the model card page , Arete-27B raised fact mean from 2.32 to 2.98. Propaganda fell from 22% to 0.9%. Answers scoring 0 dropped from 359 to 216 of 803. The biggest change came in freedom of expression. Fact score rose from 0.89 to 2.44, and propaganda fell from 60% to 1%. Capability held on Nous’s tests. Hermes Bench moved from 65.77% to 65.60%, which Nous calls noise. Terminal-Bench-2.1 rose from 67% to 70% in Nous’s harness. Nous does not claim credit for that gain. How does Arete-27B compare? Metrics Arete-27B Qwen3.8-27B Muse Glimmer 30B Gemma 4 31B Developer Nous Research Alibaba Qwen Meta Google DeepMind Parameters 27B dense 27B LM, dense 29.6B incl. vision, dense 30.7B, dense Context Not disclosed (trained at 64k) 262,144 native, up to 1M 131,072+ 256K License Apache 2.0 Apache 2.0 Apache 2.0 Apache 2.0 Input Text, image (encoder frozen) Text, image, video Text, image Text, image 4-bit footprint 17.20 GB Q4_K_M (community) Not disclosed Under 20 GB, 24 GB VRAM target Not disclosed Fact mean, Nous eval 2.98 2.32 3.02 2.58 Any propaganda, Nous eval 0.9% 22% 0.5% 0.5% Terminal-Bench 2.1 70% (Nous harness) 67% Nous harness; 73.0 official 51.7 (Meta, terminus2) Not disclosed by Google GPQA Diamond Not disclosed 89.2 83.5 84.3 Note: Arete and Qwen ran at temperature 0 in the Nous eval. Muse Glimmer and Gemma ran at 0.6. Terminal-Bench figures come from different harnesses. How can developers run it? Weights ship in BF16 on Hugging Face . No hosted inference provider serves the model yet. Community GGUF quants run in llama.cpp, LM Studio and Ollama, from 8.64 GB to 53.81 GB. The GGUF build also includes the image projector. Key Takeaways Arete-27B cuts Qwen3.8-27B propaganda answers from 22% to 0.9%. The fix took only 52.8M tokens of plain SFT, no RL. Hermes Bench held at 65.60% versus 65.77% for the base. Fact recall rose to 2.98 of 5 but still trails peers. Weights, eval and training data are open under Apache 2.0 and MIT. Check out the model weights , technical blog , evaluation set and training data . Also, feel free to follow us on Twitter and don’t forget to join our 150k+ML SubReddit and Subscribe to our Newsletter . Wait! are you on telegram? now you can join us on telegram as well. content:
Fundraiser by Yangkey Gangshar : Nepal- Tibet Floods: Help a Mountain Guide's Wife & Children
This fund brings food, housing, and school costs to Cho Cho Dawa’s wife and children
Yangkey Gangshar is organizing this fundraiser.
Our family is heartbroken by the devastating floods that swept through communities along the Nepal–Tibet border, destroying homes, livelihoods, and taking many precious lives—including our beloved first cousin, Cho Cho Dawa Dakpu Lama Tamang.
We are Yangkey, Choenyi, Tsering, and members of the Gangshar family whose roots are deeply connected to the communities affected by this tragedy. We are raising these funds for our first cousin, Cho Cho Dawa’s wife and their two young children, who are now facing an unimaginable loss and an uncertain future.
“Cho Cho” is an endearing Tibetan term for an older brother. To our family, Cho Cho Dawa was a beloved husband, father, son, brother, nephew, cousin, and friend.
A Father Who Gave Everything for His Family
At 45 years old, Cho Cho Dawa worked as a mountain guide in Nepal’s Langtang region, providing for his wife and two children. His work often took him away from home for weeks or months at a time, but he took great pride in what he did. He was known for his warmth, kindness, generosity, and joyful spirit.
Tragically, the mountains he knew so well and worked in to support his family became the place where he lost his life.
He leaves behind his wife and two young children—a daughter, 11, and a son, 7. They are now facing not only the devastating loss of their husband and father, but the uncertainty of rebuilding their lives without the person who provided for their family.
The picture attached captures Cho Cho Dawa with his family dressed in our traditional Tibetan attire while celebrating Losar, the Tibetan New Year.
Our Family’s Connection to This Community
Our connection to this region goes back generations.
Our father and his family originally came from Kyidong (Kyirong, སྐྱིད་གྲོང་) in Tibet, a place now often referred to as Gyirong in international news. In 1959, our grandparents and relatives were forced to flee Tibet and eventually found refuge and a new home in the border regions of Nepal.
Our father and his siblings grew up in the Syabru besi and Briddhim communities, where they went to school, formed lifelong friendships, and began rebuilding their lives after leaving Tibet. These communities became an important part of our family’s history and home in Nepal.
The school where our father and his siblings once studied was among the places devastated by the floods.
Yangkey was fortunate to visit Syabru besi and Briddhim in March 2014 and again with Choenyi in November 2025. During those visits, she spent time with Cho Cho Dawa, his wife, mother, and brother and was warmly welcomed into their home. The pictures included here were taken during those visits and are now incredibly meaningful to our family.
The pictures also show places we saw and experienced during our November 2025 visit. One shows a hydropower facility along the road to Syabru besi which has been damanged and another shows the homes, guesthouses, and local businesses in Syabru besi, many of which have since been washed away.
Our family was once forced to leave our homeland in Tibet and found a place in Nepal where generations of our family could rebuild their lives. Now, that same community has been devastated by another unimaginable tragedy.
What took generations to build was swept away in moments. But the lives, memories, and stories connected to these places remain.
Cho Cho Dawa is not the only loss our family is mourning.
His brother, Cho Cho Tsering, is also facing unimaginable grief, as members of his wife’s family were among those tragically swept away.
We are also mourning the many precious lives lost in this devastating tragedy, including relatives, friends, and members of the Tibetan community.
Behind every life lost is a family now facing a future without someone they love.
We are raising funds to directly support Cho Cho Dawa’s wife and two children as they begin rebuilding their lives without him.
The funds will be used specifically for:
Shelter, rent, and household expenses
School-related expenses and future education costs for the children
Medical and other essential family needs that may arise
Long-term support to help the family regain stability and rebuild their lives
100% of the funds raised through this GoFundMe will go directly toward supporting Cho Cho Dawa’s family and, if we are fortunate enough to raise more than is needed for Cho Cho Dawa’s immediate family, additional funds will be used to help other affected families in the Tibetan community of Syabru besi who have lost loved ones, homes, or their livelihoods as a result of this disaster.
Yangkey will be traveling to Nepal in approximately two weeks and plans to personally deliver the funds raised directly to the affected families. The funds will be used solely for the relief, essential needs, and family-support purposes described above.
We want to make sure the support reaches those who need it most and provides meaningful help during this incredibly difficult time.
Every donation, no matter the amount, can make a meaningful difference.
If you are unable to donate, please consider sharing this fundraiser with your friends, family, coworkers, and community. A share may help this story reach someone who is able to help.
Thank you for taking the time to hear Cho Cho Dawa’s story and for standing with his wife and children, our family, and the communities affected by this devastating tragedy.
From our family to yours, thank you for your kindness, compassion, love, and support.
Yangkey, Choenyi, Tsering & Gangshar Family
“The basic foundation of humanity is compassion and love.”

中新社台北11月8日电 据空军消息，台湾从美国购买的第二批三架F-16V Block 70战斗机周日抵达台湾。
编号为6729、6731和6732的三架飞机于上午11点左右降落在台湾东南部台东县芝行空军基地。
空军司令部在新闻发布会上表示，将按计划开展新机入役训练，逐步建立初期作战能力。
据媒体报道，这三架飞机本月早些时候从洛克希德·马丁公司位于南卡罗来纳州的工厂出发，并于当地时间11月4日抵达夏威夷。
他们的抵达是在 10 月 2 日交付第一批两架 F-16V Block 70 喷气式飞机之后抵达的。
美国2019年批准向台湾出售66架F-16V及相关设备，价值约80亿美元。
交付原本预计于 2023 年开始，并于 2026 年完成，但由于技术问题造成的延误推迟了时间表。

Taipei, Nov. 8 (CNA) The second batch of three F-16V Block 70 fighter jets purchased by Taiwan from the United States arrived in Taiwan on Sunday, according to the Air Force.
The three jets, numbered 6729, 6731 and 6732, landed at Chihhang Air Base in Taitung County, southeastern Taiwan, at around 11 a.m.
In a press statement, the Air Force Command Headquarters said it would proceed with training for the induction of the new aircraft into service as planned, gradually building up their initial operational capability.
The three jets departed from Lockheed Martin's factory in South Carolina earlier this month and arrived in Hawaii on Nov. 4 (local time), according to media reports.
Their arrival followed the delivery of the first batch of two F-16V Block 70 jets on Oct. 2.
The United States approved the sale of 66 F-16Vs and related equipment to Taiwan in 2019 for approximately US$8 billion.
Deliveries were originally expected to begin in 2023 and be completed by 2026, but delays caused by technical issues have pushed back the timetable.

中新网台北11月8日电 台湾小党的创始人兼主席因涉嫌接受中国的资金和指示参加地方选举而被单独拘留。
台南地检署周日表示，党主席林德旺涉嫌接受中共指示和资助，竞选台南市新营区太南里区长。
该办公室表示，在对林进行讯问后，检察官以涉嫌违反《反渗透法》和《选举罢免法》为由，寻求拘留他，理由是担心他可能逃跑或与他人串通销毁证据。
台南地方法院批准了他的请求，并禁止他与外界接触。
检察院表示，此次调查是在收到海外势力试图影响台湾11月28日地方选举的情报后，与新竹地检署联手展开调查。
检察官称，联合专案组周五同时进行搜查，在台南审问了 13 名嫌疑人，在新竹审问了一名嫌疑人以及 9 名证人。
除了涉嫌发现中共与2017年创立台湾人民共产党的林之间存在联系外，专案组还指控林指指示党中央委员陈震宙竞选新竹市北区武陵区长。
据当地媒体报道，林涉嫌违反《反渗透法》，接受渗透来源（即中国）的指示和资金参加选举，随后指导和资助陈的竞选活动。
据检察官称，这两个人还多次招募符合条件的选民前往中国，在那里他们受到无偿招待，当局怀疑这是试图收买选票，这违反了《选举和罢免法》。
检察官还试图拘留陈，但新竹地方法院下令以新台币 50,000 元（1,525 美元）保释金将他释放，但要求他留在登记住所。
新竹地检署预计将对这一裁决提出上诉。
其余嫌疑人和证人已被释放，等待进一步调查。

Taiwan People's Communist Party chief detained in China funding probe
To activate the text-to-speech service, please first agree to the privacy policy below.
Image from Shutterstock for illustrative purpose only
Taipei, Nov. 8 (CNA) The founder and chairman of the small Taiwan People's Communist Party has been detained incommunicado on suspicion of accepting funding and instructions from China to run in a local election.
Party Chairman Lin Te-wang (林德旺) was found to have allegedly accepted instructions and funding from the Chinese Communist Party (CCP) to run for Tainan Ward (太南里) chief in Tainan's Xinying District, the Tainan District Prosecutors Office said Sunday.
After questioning Lin, prosecutors sought to detain him on suspicion of violating the Anti-Infiltration Act and Election and Recall Act, citing concerns he could flee or collude with others to destroy evidence, the office said.
The Tainan District Court granted the request and prohibited him from having outside contact.
According to the prosecutors office, the investigation was the result of it joining forces with the Hsinchu District Prosecutors Office after each received information indicating overseas forces had sought to influence Taiwan's Nov. 28 elections for local offices.
The joint task force carried out simultaneous searches on Friday, questioning 13 suspects in Tainan and one suspect, along with nine witnesses, in Hsinchu, prosecutors said.
Beyond its alleged findings of links between the CCP and Lin, who founded the Taiwan People's Communist Party in 2017, the task force also accused him of directing party Central Committee member Chen Zhen-zhou (陳震宙) to run for Wuling Ward chief in Hsinchu City's North District.
Lin was suspected of violating the Anti-Infiltration Act by accepting instructions and funding from an infiltration source, namely China, to run in the election and subsequently direct and fund Chen's campaign, local media reported.
According to prosecutors, the two men also repeatedly recruited eligible voters to travel to China, where they received all-expenses-paid hospitality in what authorities suspect was an attempt to buy votes, which would violate the Election and Recall Act.
Prosecutors also sought to detain Chen, but the Hsinchu District Court ordered him released on NT$50,000 (US$1,525) bail but required him to remain at a registered residence.
The Hsinchu District Prosecutors Office is expected to file an appeal against the ruling.
The remaining suspects and witnesses were released pending further investigation.

香港财政司长支持长期科学研究增长
香港财政司司长陈茂波表示，香港将继续发展成为国际创新科技中心，给予科学研究认可、培育和发展空间。他以 20 世纪 80 年代的小硬盘为例，说明早期技术如何改变行业
2026 年 11 月 8 日 22:46 香港时间 · 更新于 11 月 9 日 04:25 · 阅读时间 1 分钟
香港财政司司长陈茂波表示，香港将继续发展成为国际创新科技中心，为科学研究提供所需的认可、培育和发展空间。
陈在未来科学奖晚宴上发表讲话时引用了 20 世纪 80 年代小型硬盘的例子。他指出，新技术最初可能容量有限，市场吸引力不大，但通过改进和新市场的开放，它最终可以改变整个行业。
陈说，科学研究也面临着类似的情况。他认为，今天看来困难的研究可能成为下一代探索的起点。
陈指出，未来科学奖基金会在香港注册，今年为期四天的颁奖周也在香港举行。过去十年，已有六位香港科学家获奖。
陈强调，香港是科学界的一部分，将继续支持研究发展，确保即使是小规模的研究也有机会发展。

Hong Kong finance chief backs long-term scientific research growth
Hong Kong's Financial Secretary Paul Chan said the city will continue developing as an international innovation and technology hub, giving scientific research recognition, nurturing and room to grow. He cited the 1980s small hard disk as an example of how early-stage technologies can transform indus
8 Nov 2026 at 22:46 HKT · updated 9 Nov, 04:25 · 1 min read
Hong Kong's Financial Secretary Paul Chan said the city will continue to develop as an international innovation and technology hub, giving scientific research the recognition, nurturing and room to grow it needs.
Speaking at a dinner for the Future Science Prize, Chan cited the example of the small hard disk in the 1980s. He noted that new technology may initially have limited capacity and little market appeal, but through improvements and the opening of new markets it can eventually transform an entire industry.
Chan said scientific research faced a similar situation. Research that seems difficult today may become the starting point for the next generation's exploration, he argued.
The Future Science Prize Foundation is registered in Hong Kong, and this year's four-day prize week is also being held in the city, Chan noted. Over the past decade, six Hong Kong scientists have won the prize.
Chan emphasised that Hong Kong is part of this scientific community and will continue to support research development, ensuring that even research that begins on a small scale has the chance to grow.

title: Inside ARTEX: AI Hacking Tools, Exposed Servers and South Korean Bank Breaches
zh_title: ARTEX 内部：人工智能黑客工具、暴露的服务器和韩国银行漏洞
summary: Hunt.io 追踪了影响七家韩国金融机构的 ARTEX 服务器和人工智能黑客工具。 2026 年 9 月底至 10 月初期间，七家韩国金融机构的数据通过面向互联网的系统遭到泄露。约 66,000 至 67,000 人以及约 2,200 家企业受到影响，个人、就业、收入和贷款数据被曝光。 Hunt.io 深入研究了该活动背后的基础设施，其发现为 CrowdStrike 和 Genians 已经发布的内容增添了很多内容。 CrowdStrike 10 月 7 日报道和 Genians 安全中心
content:
Hunt.io 追踪了影响七家韩国金融机构的 ARTEX 服务器和人工智能黑客工具。 2026 年 9 月底至 10 月初期间，七家韩国金融机构的数据通过面向互联网的系统遭到泄露。约 66,000 至 67,000 人以及约 2,200 家企业受到影响，个人、就业、收入和贷款数据被曝光。 Hunt.io 深入研究了该活动背后的基础设施，其发现为 CrowdStrike 和 Genians 已经发布的内容增添了很多内容。 CrowdStrike 于 10 月 7 日报道，Genians 安全中心于 10 月 12 日报道，均指向 ARTEX，这是一个在中国开发并获得 AGPL-3.0 许可的开源自主渗透测试框架。 CrowdStrike 的评估有一定的把握，认为该组织是由一个受金钱驱动的讲中文的个人操控的，而不是一个既定的威胁组织。 DeepSeek v4.1 Flash 是主要模型，GLM 5.3 和 Grok 4.6 作为备份，部分通过经销商域 xcai[.]pro 实现。公共指标是位于 38.244.50[.]120 的服务器，该服务器托管 ARTEX 控制台，以及一个香港地址和 9 个代理。 Genians 表示，ARTEX GitHub 存储库和 Docker 镜像已于 10 月 11 日删除，但分支和镜像仍然存在。 “CrowdStrike 的评估有一定的把握，认为该操作者是一个讲中文的个人，其动机是经济利益，而不是一个既定的威胁组织。” Hunt.io 发布的报告中写道。
“据报道，基础设施部分通过经销商域 xcai[.]pro 访问这些服务。两份报告都描述了双服务器配置，包括用作主要基础设施的香港 IP 地址和托管 ARTEX 控制台的 38.244.50[.]120 。” Hunt.io 在发布前通知了相关国家 CERT，并表示该报告没有任何个人记录或凭证。该公司自己的扫描显示 38.244.50[.]120 位于洛杉矶 Cogent 的网络上，有 15 个开放端口。 ARTEX 登录页面的中文标题是“自主渗透测试控制台”，出现在端口 443 和 8090 上。其他服务包括 Gemini2API 管理控制台和 Tinyproxy 服务器。 Hunt.io 在其 AttackCapture 平台上搜索该地址时，发现了另一个开放目录：23.248.226[.]250，这是位于香港 AS138415 上的跳转服务器。它在 2 个子目录中包含 42 个文件，总共 105 MB，该平台已于 9 月 5 日、9 月 26 日和 10 月 5 日记录了警告。其中的一个文件将 38.244.50[.]120 命名为跳转主机，其注释告诉操作员切勿将凭据粘贴到会话中。它位于一个开放的目录中。三个脚本支持链接。他们保持反向 SSH 隧道处于活动状态，运行本地中继，并将文件复制到跳转主机，其中一条隧道名为 grok2api，凭证文件还保存智普 AI 的 GLM 模型、兼容 OpenAI 的中继和代理服务的密钥。
这解释了多个语言模型如何在一次活动中运行。人工智能设置是最引人注目的部分。状态文件显示该工具是 Claude Code 本身，版本 2.1.221，自 8 月 4 日以来启动了 510 次，但它没有与 Anthropic 对话。一个小型代理 ds-models-shim.py 通过伪造模型列表并向 DeepSeek 发送请求来修复兼容性问题，另一个代理 xcai-effort-shim.py 添加推理设置，因为 DeepSeek 后端会跳过其推理步骤。该路线从 Claude Code 出发，通过 Claude Code Router（一个开源软件）

【原文 English Original】
Hunt.io traced ARTEX servers and AI-powered hacking tools used in breaches affecting seven South Korean financial institutions. Between late September and early October 2026, seven South Korean financial institutions had data breached through internet-facing systems. About 66,000 to 67,000 people and around 2,200 corporations were affected, and personal, employment, income and loan data was exposed. Hunt.io dug into the infrastructure behind the campaign , and its findings add a lot to what CrowdStrike and Genians already published. CrowdStrike reported on October 7 and Genians Security Center on October 12 , and both pointed to ARTEX , an open-source autonomous penetration testing framework developed in China and licensed under AGPL-3.0. CrowdStrike assessed with moderate confidence that a single Chinese-speaking individual motivated by money ran it, and not an established threat group. DeepSeek v4.1 Flash was the main model, with GLM 5.3 and Grok 4.6 as backups, reached partly through a reseller domain, xcai[.]pro. The public indicators were a server at 38.244.50[.]120, which hosted the ARTEX console, plus a Hong Kong address and nine proxies. Genians said the ARTEX GitHub repository and Docker image were removed on October 11, though forks and mirrors remain. “CrowdStrike assessed with moderate confidence that the operator was a single Chinese-speaking individual motivated by financial gain rather than an established threat group.” reads the report published by Hunt.io. “The infrastructure reportedly accessed these services in part through the reseller domain xcai[.]pro . Both reports described a two-server configuration, consisting of a Hong Kong-based IP address used as primary infrastructure and 38.244.50[.]120 , which hosted the ARTEX console.” Hunt.io notified the relevant national CERT before publishing, and says the report holds no personal records or credentials. The company’s own scanning showed 38.244.50[.]120 sits on Cogent’s network in Los Angeles, with 15 open ports. The ARTEX login page, with a Chinese title meaning “autonomous penetration testing console”, appears on ports 443 and 8090. Other services include a Gemini2API admin console and a Tinyproxy server. Searching its AttackCapture platform for that address, Hunt.io found another open directory at 23.248.226[.]250, a jump server in Hong Kong on AS138415. It held 42 files in 2 subdirectories, 105 MB in all, and the platform had logged warnings on September 5, September 26 and October 5. A file in it names 38.244.50[.]120 as the jump host, and its own comment tells the operator never to paste the credentials into a session. It sat in an open directory. Three scripts back up the link. They keep reverse SSH tunnels alive, run a local relay, and copy files to the jump host, one tunnel is named grok2api, and the credentials file also holds keys for Zhipu AI’s GLM models, an OpenAI-compatible relay and a proxy service. That explains how several language models ran in one campaign. The AI setup is the most striking part. A state file shows the harness is Claude Code itself, version 2.1.221, started 510 times since August 4, but it isn’t talking to Anthropic. A small proxy, ds-models-shim.py, fixes a compatibility problem by faking a model list and sending requests to DeepSeek, and another, xcai-effort-shim.py, adds a reasoning setting because the DeepSeek backend otherwise skips its reasoning step. The route runs from Claude Code through Claude Code Router, an open-source project, to xcai and then to DeepSeek. “A small local proxy, ds-models-shim.py , addresses a compatibility issue: the official /v1/models endpoint returns a 404 response when queried against a non-Anthropic backend, preventing Claude Code from discovering the available models. The shim intercepts that specific request and returns a locally defined model list containing deepseek-v4-pro and deepseek-flash . All other requests are forwarded to api.deepseek.com/anthropic.” states the report. The same file counts 19 custom skills, reusable instruction sets for the agent, with 147 recorded uses. They cover code audit, reconnaissance, web injection, WAF bypass testing, authentication testing, Telegram Mini Apps, APK download and decompiling, cloud phone control and payment logic testing. Next to the payment skill sat three self-registered test accounts with tokens for a cash-in deposit API, dated September 12, and a comment calls them an authorized, self-built test. The setup fits testing for insecure direct object reference flaws, a technique CrowdStrike and Genians described against Korean loan and inquiry services. The directory also held supporting tools. A script queried FOFA, a Chinese asset search engine like Shodan, through a third-party API, and a comment says the primary membership had expired and a backup key was in use. Proxy scripts enumerated a rotating proxy service at 154.201.79[.]246:443, where 79 unique exit IPs showed up among the first 100 identities tested. A separate directory at 23.248.226[.]250:8001 held a small staged setup for JNDI and LDAP exploitation, retrieved on October 5 at 03:42 UTC. It confirms command execution through a DNS callback, and one script lets web and LDAP traffic share a single port. Hunt.io’s analysis describes the tooling without publishing steps to reproduce it. Other recovered files include tools aimed at a cryptocurrency exchange’s admin session and withdrawals, Linux privilege escalation exploits, iOS probe source code and Android kernel and firmware utilities. Hunt.io says their connection to the Korean breaches isn’t confirmed. Hunt.io then showed how to hunt ARTEX servers. Searching for an ARTEX certificate issuer returned 19 IP addresses, and searching its malware classification returned 1,303 addresses across 30 countries, led by the United States, China and Hong Kong. Those figures show where addresses are registered, not where the operator sits. “The result returned 19 distinct IP addresses, including 38.244.50[.]120. This method is precise but limited to hosts that expose a matching certificate. Systems using a different certificate will not appear in these results.” continues the report. Matching the console’s page title returned about 1,300 IPs, and a looser search found 21 title strings, 19 of them likely ARTEX consoles, in English, Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Russian, Portuguese and Vietnamese. A malware-name search in AttackCapture gave 280 results with open directories. One at 130.94.31[.]86:18888 in Seoul held two small scripts, and another at 156.251.11[.]39 held an SMB reconnaissance toolkit whose test script writes a file named artex_probe_11876.txt. More hosts held exploitation kits for DedeCMS and FangCMS, a CAPTCHA bypass suite, a RuoYi and Spring administrative console exploit and CAPTCHA-based login automation. Together they show the framework attracting many operators. For defenders, the advice is plain. Remove public access and put administration behind VPNs or allowlists, and reset SSH passwords and rotate API keys, proxy credentials and tokens that exposed files may have revealed. Patch internet-facing services, watch for unexpected LDAP and JNDI activity, DNS callbacks and remote script downloads, and store secrets in a managed vault with least-privilege permissions. Also restrict access to model gateways, watch their requests, and enforce compliance rules on managed phones. Hunt.io’s lesson is that an investigation shouldn’t stop at the first list of indicators, because The company also published indicators of compromise in its analysis. “The findings highlight risks associated with exposed administrative services, reusable credentials, remote access tunnels, proxy infrastructure, and exploitation tooling.” concludes the report. Amazon’s new basic Kindle proves you don’t need all the bells and whistles
9:18 AM PST · November 7, 2026
In October, Amazon announced its refreshed Kindle lineup, its first significant design overhaul in years. The highlights included a new edge-to-edge design that eliminated traditional raised bezels, thinner and lighter Paperwhite and Colorsoft models with better displays, and page-turning accessories like a Bluetooth remote and a magnetic cover with page-turn buttons.
However, given the impact of the global memory-chip shortage driven by the AI boom, the new Kindles also debuted with pricing that had increased by $40 to $50 across the lineup. That makes it more difficult for the average consumer to consider buying one of the more premium devices.
For that reason, the Kindle I most wanted to get my hands on was the 6-inch entry-level device, which starts at $169.99 for the ad-free version. With the price hikes, this is the Kindle that will remain the most affordable to new e-reader buyers.
The question I weighed was whether or not the basic Kindle is even worth buying at this price when there are arguably better Kindles on the market. The answer, after a couple of weeks of testing, is yes — if you can live without the bells and whistles and prefer a smaller, lighter device.
On the 6-inch Kindle, there’s no warm light to reduce eye strain, no color display, no auto-adjusting brightness, no option to use the page-turn cover, and it’s not waterproof. Obviously, because of its size, the screen is smaller, as is the battery. Battery life is 6 weeks compared with the Paperwhite’s 12 weeks or Colorsoft’s 8 weeks.
Still, even this basic Kindle has seen improvements of its own, mostly from a physical design perspective.
The plastic 2026 Kindle is 11% lighter and 14% thinner than the 2024 model, weighing 140g versus 158g and measuring 6.85mm thick versus 8mm. While this seems like a small change, the 18-gram difference is noticeable and particularly welcome for a device you’re likely to carry in your purse or bag. Plus, it makes it easier to hold for hours on end when you’re really binging your way through a book.
(The aluminum version, meanwhile, is slightly heavier at 162g, or 4 grams more than the 2024 Kindle, though it still benefits from the slimmer design.)
And despite being the “starter” Kindle, the 6-inch basic device still received the new flush-front screen update. This makes it more comfortable to hold in your hand, especially for those long reading sessions. Amazon explained that you don’t have to worry about no longer having a bezel to rest your thumb upon, either, as the new Kindles have been updated to detect a dead zone in the capacitive touch that will readjust to account for the fact that your finger is there.
In practice, that doesn’t mean you can just press your thumb down anywhere on the Kindle’s screen as you hold it — doing so would register this as an attempt to highlight or look up a word. Instead, it means you can rest your thumb or fingers on the outer edge of the Kindle’s screen (the colored border) without triggering an unintentional tap, even though some of your finger will be touching part of the Kindle’s capacitive screen.
In terms of the software, the new basic Kindle is a bit snappier than its 2024 predecessor. This is most noticeable when opening books, which Amazon claims to be 30% faster.
If you’re coming from the 2019 Kindle Basic, the 2026 version is an even bigger upgrade, as you gain USB-C, more storage (from 4GB to 8GB to now 16GB or 32GB), the new flush screen, and the screen resolution jumps from 167 ppi to 300 ppi. It’s faster, thinner, and lighter, too, and the battery lasts weeks longer.
Another perk about the basic Kindle beyond its small size (this thing fits in your jeans’ back pocket!), is that you can now pay a little more for an upgraded version with an aluminum backing instead of plastic and more storage. The new $189.99 aluminum option comes in Seagrass and Alpine Sky hues, and ships with 32GB of storage. Meanwhile, the $169.99 plastic model offers 16GB of storage.
However, even if you go for the less expensive option, you can at least now pick a fun color other than black (aka Graphite), as Amazon has introduced a cheery purple option called Ube. (I almost wish I’d gone for this one, just for the whimsy of it, even though I prefer the feel of the aluminum.)
I should point out that you can use the Kindle Click, the new Bluetooth remote for page turning, with the basic Kindle, but I’m not sure why you’d need to, if not for some accessibility-related reason. The 6-inch Kindle was already the smallest, and now it’s lighter and easier to hold, too. (But perhaps I just don’t get the appeal of the remote? I’ve barely used the remote with my Kobo either!)
The big thing to consider here is whether you want to spend this much on a Kindle that lacks a warm light. While this is something of a personal preference, for some readers, no warm light is a dealbreaker. The warm light shifts the color tone of the Kindle’s display from a cooler bluish-white to a softer amber glow, which is meant to help reduce eye strain and improve reading conditions in low light or at night.
Whether you need this feature depends on where you like to read and how long your sessions tend to be. If you read nightly in bed with little light, you might prefer paying extra for a $199.99 16GB Kindle Paperwhite. (That version only comes in Graphite. The 32GB Paperwhite can come in Seaglass, too, but is $249.99).
If you often read by the pool or on vacation, you also might want to upgrade to a waterproof Kindle.
But if you can live without the extra features and want the best purse- or pocket-sized device, the 6-inch Kindle is still a viable option.

title: 顏純鈎：賣友求榮非君子所為，為虎作倀是背叛初心

content: 作者臉書  2026-11-6 寫了 一篇短文指責張劍虹 ，不料引來有史以來最洶湧的罵聲。有人說污點證人也未必造成 多大傷害，有人說我站著說話不腰疼，有人說我分化民主派，看來錯不在張劍虹，錯在我。 張劍虹除了轉作污點證人，等於賣友求榮之外，又接受安排到深圳參訪，在官媒電視台為中共涂脂抹粉，與他多年追隨黎智英，在壹傳媒掌管一人之下千人之上的重要職位時的初衷，來一個一百八十度大轉彎，而且轉得心安理得，這委實令我看不起他。 有網友說我應該去體驗一下中共牢房的滋味，好像我沒有坐牢倒是我的錯。我要承認我相當幸運，我退休前後重拾政治評論之筆，在蘋果日報先用筆名後用真名發表文章。2018年我離開香港返回加拿大，原因是家人都在外面，而我對香港的前景也相當悲觀，其時反送中運動尚無跡象，我以為此後與香港將不會有什麼干係。 反送中後，即使遠在千里之外也坐不住，我每日關心香港局勢，寫短評支持香港人的反抗運動，我不是吃太飽沒事幹，只是憎恨中共的專制統治，不忍香港被中共糟塌。我每日燃燒有限腦汁，本來就不圖什麼，只圖消解內心的愛憎。 有網友說我應該去體驗一下中共牢房的滋味。我同意如果我留在香港，反送中期間，必定也忍不住要寫評論，寫了評論也有可能被黎智英邀請在蘋果寫社論，國安法下來，我也極有可能離不開香港，要在中共牢房裡過我餘下的日子。 今日人在千里之外，想像一旦被判刑，我在牢裡會有什麼表現。我承認我未必做得到像黎智英和鄒幸彤那樣英勇不屈，肝膽照日月，我可能為減免一些刑期而選擇認罪，但要我做到像張劍虹那樣賣友求榮、損人利己我絕對做不到。 我生性高傲，視個人尊嚴有甚於性命，我不習慣向權貴脅肩諂笑，也不喜歡看別人的臉色做人，更無法忍受出賣手足換取個人安樂那種損人利己的骯髒事。因此，我最大限度是去到認罪，而絕不會像張劍虹那樣，選擇做污點證人。 認罪只是承認我犯了你中共的國安法，並不意味著我承認參與民主抗爭有違天理人情，有違香港原有的法律。我只是在人屋檐下，不得不低頭而已，我在法庭上認了罪，我在內心會永遠保有我的初衷。 有人說污點證人也未必會傷害手足，那是太天真的想法，對中共太缺乏了解。AI資料顯示，公民黨的楊岳橋、譚文豪、郭家麒三人，曾主動為警方錄取「無條件口供」，希望轉為控方證人，但因提供的資料「沒有價值」而不被接受。 也就是說，你想做污點證人，還要看你提供的內幕有沒有殺傷力？如果對有關人不能造成足夠的傷害，那些資料就沒有價值，中共才不會那麼傻，無端讓你減刑。明白這一點，便可推測，張劍虹提供的材料，必定對黎智英造成可以讓中共滿意的傷害。 張劍虹與黎智英合作一二十年，又是最重要的助手，其間有多少不為人知的內幕，足以幫助中共定罪，我們外人雖無從得知，但如果是無足輕重的交代，中共又怎麼會那麼好死給他減刑？ AI又告訴我，因反送中運動和國安法而被捕的香港民主派人士，總計有10060人，其中選擇充當污點證人的只有13人，我不知道這些數字是否準確，但至少證明，選擇成為污點證人的民主派人士，僅不足被捕人士的一個零頭，證明大多數手足還是明白自己的道德底線在哪裡。 只是踐踏自己而不傷害別人，那只是自己的尊嚴有價而已，道德上無虧，但如果你利己之餘還要損人，那就不只是自己的尊嚴不值錢了，你是以他人的痛苦來換取自己的安樂。張劍虹轉作污點證人，毫無疑問將加重黎智英的刑期，否則，他都沒有資格充當控方證人。 我之所以不恥張劍虹，主要原因是此風不可長。被捕的民主派人士，如果不能堅持自己的初衷，堅信民主的普世價值，那至少也應該堅持做人的道德底線，不能以損害他人利益來讓自己得益。如果大部份民主派被捕人士都有樣學樣，那在民主派內部必然形成一種歪風，便是人人都以互相揭發為榮，以互相傷害為得計，那將成什麼世界？那才是中共喜聞樂見的大好事，而香港民主派，從牢裡到牢外，都將成一盤散沙。 近日黃之鋒被港共重判十年，之鋒也沒有選擇轉作污點證人。他自十四歲起就投身香港民主運動，其間發起與參與眾多政治抗爭，他與香港民主派不同時代的領導人，都有過深入的交接，相信很多事情都是他親歷，他知道其中任何細節。 如果黃之鋒要為減刑而出賣手足，那他可以傷害多少人？如果他出面指證黎智英，而黎智英不忿他的不義，也反手指證黃之鋒，還有更多民運領袖紛紛互篤背脊，那中共不但坐收漁利，而且足可證明他的專制政權的正當性，那我們香港人被踐踏豈不是活該？ 我希望那些罵我的網友好好想一想，我相信他們多數人只是出於對被捕手足的同情與不忍，而不是真正認同張劍虹的所作所為。賣友求榮是最不堪的下作行徑，做人如非去到極端自私，是做不出這種事來的。 我說我們對黎智英、鄒幸彤他們，雖不可及，心嚮往之，就是我們盡可能以他們的精神風範為楷模，雖然做不到，但也不要去到太下作，不要超越做人的底線，我對自己也只有如此的期許。賣友求榮這種事，對於稍有良知的人，是一種永生的恥辱，你要如何面對自己的尊嚴，面對親友的鄙視，面對子孫後代的質疑？ 人各有志，各人頭上一片天，我只想問那些罵我的網友，如果你們處在張劍虹的處境，你們是否也會選擇作污點證人？這種事關乎一生榮辱，千萬不可口輕輕，想做就去做。

title: 影音筆記：台灣選舉漫遊
summary: 臨近台灣地方大選，我們製作了一部《台灣選舉漫遊錄》，走訪台北、高雄、花蓮和新竹，看看這些地方的政治，和選舉版圖背後沒說的故事。 高雄美濃和台北大稻埕，一個是南部的客家庄，一個是台北最老的街區之一。如果只看選舉結果，這兩個地方幾乎站在光譜的兩端：美濃常被說是藍綠五五波，或稍微偏向國民黨（藍營）的地方；大稻埕所在的大同區，則是不少人口中的民進黨（綠營）大本營。 整理影片素材時，我發現這些散落的訪談片段，好像都在繞著同一個問題打轉：一個人，是怎麼開始在乎一個地方的？ 2026年10
content: 臨近台灣地方大選，我們製作了一部《台灣選舉漫遊錄》，走訪台北、高雄、花蓮和新竹，看看這些地方的政治，和選舉版圖背後沒說的故事。 高雄美濃和台北大稻埕，一個是南部的客家庄，一個是台北最老的街區之一。如果只看選舉結果，這兩個地方幾乎站在光譜的兩端：美濃常被說是藍綠五五波，或稍微偏向國民黨（藍營）的地方；大稻埕所在的大同區，則是不少人口中的民進黨（綠營）大本營。 整理影片素材時，我發現這些散落的訪談片段，好像都在繞著同一個問題打轉：一個人，是怎麼開始在乎一個地方的？ 2026年10月22日，高雄美濃。攝：陳焯煇/端傳媒 讀報的人 在美濃，幾乎每位受訪者都不約而同提到一件事：這裡的書香氣息。 返鄉青年小汶記得，每天都會有一份報紙送到家，爺爺看完不多說什麼，但都整整齊齊地把報紙疊好；在美濃國中教了二十多年書的橘子老師則說，她剛嫁來時最驚訝的，是眼睛已經看不太清楚的老阿伯，還每天在看報紙。 「他們都建構了一段自己的中心思想。」橘子老師說，即使是農民，對農業也有自己的見解。也難怪美濃的協會多得驚人，有腳踏車協會、八色鳥協會、各地的同鄉會，還有能展現在地文化氣質的「博士學人會」。在橘子老師的故鄉，大家遇到困難，常常是抱怨完就結束了，但美濃不一樣，抱怨完會開會，開完會就行動。 聽到這裡，我忍不住想：藍綠能在這裡打成平盤，會不會就是這樣來的？一個大家都讀、都想、都能獨立思考的地方，本來就很難被一種聲音帶著走。 小汶說，長輩在三合院裡聊政治，從來不趕小孩走，也不搞一言堂。自己家裡多是支持民進黨的聲音，但她能在國中同學口中聽到「家裡要投馬英九」，理由是「因為他比較帥」。小汶回家轉述，大人也只是笑一笑，沒有人說誰對誰錯。那是她第一次意識到，原來投票不一定要跟著政黨走，也可以是因為「這個人」。 這種選人不選黨的習慣，到現在也沒變。小汶說，對美濃人而言，重點往往不是你代表哪一黨，而是你的政見裡有沒有美濃。想出來選里長？你得先問問左右五戶鄰居認不認識你。 當然，這只是我的假設，五五波的背後還有人口結構、產業、地方派系等許多成因。但「讀得多、想得多」這件事，或許讓這裡的政治分歧相對健康，而不針鋒相對。橘子老師說，美濃人之間的政治立場不同，但大家都會守住那條界線。你的容忍度高，我們就多聊，說不定可以互相說服；你的容忍度低，我們就各退一步，不聊政治。 瓦豆燈光創辦人江佶洋。攝：陳焯煇/端傳媒 上街的人 「沒有學識，你是不會上街的。」這句話，是在大稻埕聽到的。 瓦豆燈光老闆的同學曾經批評，上街頭的都是沒讀書、知識水平低的人。老闆的反駁很直接：連吃飽都有問題的人，根本不會上街頭。一定是先有人提出論述、有想法、有號召力，才會有人跟上。 他自己就是這樣長大的。在那個沒有網路、沒有通訊軟體的年代，鄭南榕的《自由時代》是他們家的課外讀物，集會的消息就登在上面；就算無法取得這樣的「非法刊物」，其實鄰里之間也會互通集會遊行的訊息。一家人吃完飯，參加政見發表會、遊行抗議，都是很稀鬆平常的事。 雖然老闆是從在地經驗、陣營視角出發，但我聽著聽著，想到的卻是美濃。反水庫運動、黃蝶祭，以及前面一長串的協會和同鄉會，美濃蓬勃的社會參與背後，不也是一群讀報、讀書、有自己見解的人嗎？ 所以當有人選擇走上街頭時，我們或許不該急著把他們定性成被煽動、暴動。願意開口說的、勇於走上街的、甚至為此付出龐大代價的，往往是在心裡想過很多遍的人。 懷抱希望的人 瓦豆老闆還分享了一個有趣的觀察。早年的造勢場合，音樂一放就是〈黃昏的故鄉〉，「悲情」往往是活動的主旋律。直到 1994 年陳水扁參選台北市長，第一次用「快樂、希望」作為訴求。 他就這樣看了四十年，看著民進黨的競選歌曲從〈春天的花蕊〉、〈伊是咱的寶貝〉到〈自信勇敢咱的名〉，一次比一次好聽、街頭一次比一次像嘉年華。老闆說，那是一個民族開始站起來的樣子。 聽到這裡，老闆眼中泛著的欣慰讓我深受感動。悲情動員有它的歷史，那些傷痛也都是真的，但正是我們願意正視，能公平、公開地討論這段歷史，後來的人才能放下一點重量，帶著社會往前走。一個社會走得夠遠了，我們或許才能用希望，而不只是恐懼、仇恨來凝聚彼此。 不論是哪次選舉、哪個陣營，希望候選人都能帶領選民，一起想像地方的未來，而不只是攻擊對手、情緒動員。 大稻埕開咖啡館的盧郭老闆。攝：陳焯煇/端傳媒 收集故事的人 這一集，我們原本想拍的是選舉，但最後拍到的，反而是一部收集故事的漫遊錄。 在大稻埕開咖啡館的盧郭老闆是深綠支持者。他講起自己高中時讀到民主前輩們的故事，說了一句很沉重的話：「你知道了，就很難回去了。」 回頭看這兩個地方，我想「知道」大概就是一切的起點。知道這塊土地擁有什麼、發生過什麼，人才會開始在乎它。 但光是在乎還不夠，還得知道該怎麼做。在美濃，當年參與反水庫運動的作詞人鍾永豐，也把如何組織、如何跟政府溝通的經驗分享給下一代；瓦豆老闆則記得，開票那晚，爸媽會和鄰居約好每人帶一支手電筒到開票所，怕有人會製造停電、做票。 這些「知道」都不是課本教的，而是長輩一次次上街、一次次在餐桌上說給下一代聽的。 也難怪瓦豆老闆一直拜託身邊的人要讀文學、讀歷史。因為不讀，就沒辦法對下一代講故事，也感受不到今天能自由參與政治，背後有多少重量。 所以不管是美濃的五五波，還是大稻埕的一片綠，人們選擇的方向不同，在乎的方式也不同，但都是先知道了、想過了，才決定站出來。就像盧郭老闆說的，一旦知道了，就很難再回去了。 下一集，我們將帶著你們前往花蓮、新竹。看看一個人口嚴重外流的地方，和人口大量移入的城市，他們會出現怎麼樣的政治差異。

title: Two Chinese companies cleared to buy banned Nvidia AI chips have empty offices and unknown addresses
zh_title: 两家获准购买被禁英伟达人工智能芯片的中国公司办公室空荡荡，地址未知
summary: 调查发现，两家获准购买Nvidia H200芯片的中国公司的地址导致办公室空荡荡，而且大楼的接待员也不熟悉这些地址。据《纽约时报》报道，这些公司不仅拥有空置的办公室，而且还拥有空置的办公室。他们的高管经常与因与中国军方合作并向中国军方提供先进技术而受到美国制裁的其他公司有联系。这一消息揭示了人们的担忧，即美国商务部只是简单地在 GPU 出口许可证申请上盖上橡皮图章，而不是仔细审查每一项申请的有效性。
content:
调查发现，两家获准购买Nvidia H200芯片的中国公司的地址导致办公室空荡荡，而且大楼的接待员也不熟悉这些地址。据《纽约时报》报道，这些公司不仅拥有空置的办公室，而且还拥有空置的办公室。他们的高管经常与因与中国军方合作并向中国军方提供先进技术而受到美国制裁的其他公司有联系。这一消息揭示了人们的担忧，即美国商务部只是简单地在 GPU 出口许可证申请上盖上橡皮图章，而不是仔细审查每一份申请是否与北京存在潜在联系。白宫国家安全委员会前中国事务主任丽莎·托宾 (Liza Tobin) 对该刊物表示：“我非常担心商务部或英伟达都没有进行必要的尽职调查，以确保许可条款得到遵守。”其中许多获得批准的公司包括百度、比亚迪、特斯拉上海等知名实体，以及此前被美国市场列入黑名单的中兴通讯、阿里巴巴、腾讯和字节跳动。然而，该机构的调查还显示，两家相对不知名的公司获得了批准：New Matrix 和 Maginfra。两家公司的办公室都是空的，只有一些办公家具，附近工作的人表示，他们从未听说过这家公司，也没有见过有人去过这些废弃的地方。
据报道，New Matrix 网站也没有包含任何有关其所有者或历史的信息，尽管上市公司记录显示该网站是由李斌创立的，李斌和其他两位主要所有者与 Wise Road 有联系，Wise Road 是一家因帮助北京获取敏感芯片技术而受到美国制裁的中国私募股权公司。此外，李先生还担任清华紫光集团（一家由中国政府部分持股的科技集团）的董事长，并拥有新华三半导体技术公司（New H3C Semiconductor Technologies），该公司也因与中国军方合作而被列入美国商务部的实体清单。另一方面，Maginfra 被怀疑与浪潮有联系，自 2023 年以来，华盛顿因支持中国人民解放军而将浪潮列入黑名单，两家公司共享人员、专利和类似的政府所有权结构。不过，这两家公司并未被列为英伟达人工智能芯片的最终用户。相反，他们应该将它们组装成人工智能服务器，然后将其转发给最终用户，尽管尚不清楚他们的客户是谁。除了这些可疑的非实体之外，另一家获得 H200 GPU 购买许可的公司也存在一些可疑链接。据报道，浙江银盾云科技的高管与睿智智能计算技术集团的创始人有关系，该集团是一家数据中心运营商，已向中国军事承包商出售计算能力。
据报道，它的部分运营也是在 Range 数据中心进行的。唐纳德·特朗普总统于 2025 年 4 月禁止出口 Nvidia AI GPU，即使是那些为满足华盛顿为 AI 处理器设定的性能上限而定制的 GPU。去年年底，总统推翻了这一决定，以换取销量减少 25%，但第一批 H200 仍需要八个多月的时间才抵达中国。今年头几个月，北京方面拒绝为中国科技公司购买芯片开绿灯，导致了延误。但一旦中国取消了对英伟达芯片的进口禁令，几家中国公司就申请了许可证

【原文 English Original】
An investigation has found that addresses for two Chinese companies approved to purchase Nvidia H200 chips led to empty offices, and the receptionists at the buildings were unfamiliar with them. According to The New York Times , these companies didn’t just have empty offices; their executives are often linked to other firms sanctioned by the United States for working with and providing advanced technology to the Chinese military. This news has revealed concerns that the U.S. Department of Commerce is simply rubber-stamping GPU export license applications instead of scrutinizing each one for potential links to Beijing. “I have a ton of concerns that neither the Commerce Department or Nvidia is doing the due diligence needed to ensure that the licensing terms are being followed,” former China director for the White House National Security Council Liza Tobin told the publication. Many of these approved companies include well-known entities like Baidu, BYD, Tesla Shanghai, as well as ZTE , which has previously been blacklisted from the U.S. market, Alibaba, Tencent, and ByteDance. However, the outfit’s investigation also revealed approval for two relatively unknown firms: New Matrix and Maginfra. The offices for both companies were empty shells with some office furniture, and people working nearby said they’d never heard of the company or seen anyone go to the deserted spaces. The New Matrix website also reportedly did not contain any information about its owners or its history, although public company records reveal that it was founded by Li Bin, who, along with two other primary owners, are connected to Wise Road, a Chinese private equity firm sanctioned by the U.S. for helping Beijing acquire sensitive chip technologies. Furthermore, Mr. Li chairs Tsinghua Unigroup, a tech conglomerate partly owned by the Chinese government, and owns New H3C Semiconductor Technologies, which has also been added to the Commerce Department’s Entity List for cooperating with the Chinese military. Maginfra, on the other hand, is suspected of being linked to Inspur, which Washington has b lacklisted since 2023 for supporting the People’s Liberation Army, with both companies sharing personnel, patents, and a similar government ownership structure. These two firms aren’t listed as the final users of Nvidia’s AI chips, though. Instead, they’re supposed to assemble them into AI servers, which would then be forwarded to a final user, although it’s unclear who their customers are. Aside from these questionable non-entities, another company that received a license to purchase H200 GPUs has some suspicious links. Zhejiang Yindun Cloud Technology’s executives are reportedly related to the founder of Range Intelligent Computing Technology Group, a data center operator that has sold compute capacity to Chinese military contractors. It’s also reportedly partly operating out of a Range data center. President Donald Trump banned the export of Nvidia AI GPUs in April 2025 , even those customized to meet the performance ceiling Washington set for AI processors. The president reversed the decision late last year in exchange for a 25% cut of the sale, but it still took more than eight months for the first H200 shipments to arrive in China . Beijing’s refusal to give Chinese tech companies the green light to buy the chips for the first few months of the year caused the delay. But once China lifted its import ban on Nvidia chips, several Chinese companies applied for licenses to buy them, and The New York Times reported that around two dozen firms have already received approval, including these questionable ones.

title: 'Permanent, serious' dialogue needed with China on AI: tech-focused lawmaker
zh_title: 需要与中国就人工智能进行“永久、认真”的对话：以技术为重点的立法者
summary: 众议员詹姆斯·沃金肖 (James Walkinshaw) 对人工智能监管的愿景包括与中国保持“永久、认真”的对话，以减轻强大的人工智能模型带来的风险。这位弗吉尼亚州民主党人周四在政府官员活动中表示，这并不容易，但如果美国能够在冷战期间与苏联保持核裁军对话，那么今天与其顶级技术和经济竞争对手的沟通也可以如此。这些对话“绝对必要，而且在某些方面，我们的动机是一致的，对吧？中国共产党确实
content:
众议员詹姆斯·沃金肖 (James Walkinshaw) 对人工智能监管的愿景包括与中国保持“永久、认真”的对话，以减轻强大的人工智能模型带来的风险。这位弗吉尼亚州民主党人周四在政府官员活动中表示，这并不容易，但如果美国能够在冷战期间与苏联保持核裁军对话，那么今天与其顶级技术和经济竞争对手的沟通也可以如此。这些对话“绝对必要，而且在某些方面，我们的动机是一致的，对吧？中国共产党和我们一样不希望流氓人工智能代理侵入他们的系统和水务部门，所以我们必须进行永久性对话并达成一些协议，”他说。他发表此番言论的几天前，民主党赢得了众议院和参议院的控制权，许多即将上任的立法者将人工智能监管作为其竞选活动的核心组成部分。目前尚不完全清楚，在一个主要专注于促进技术创新、同时将法规保持在最低限度的政府的领导下，立法者将如何着手制定人工智能法律。白宫还必须应对参众两院新多数派的更强烈反对，这可能迫使他们坐到谈判桌前通过复杂的立法。沃金肖并不是第一位倡导美中人工智能对话的国会议员，尽管他的立场增加了这些评论的分量。
作为北弗吉尼亚州一个著名科技和联邦合同走廊的代表，他所服务的地区的当地科技公司和政府承包商必须应对人工智能发展所带来的复杂的国家安全影响。推动对话是在 7 月份发生的一次具有里程碑意义的事件之后进行的，当时 OpenAI 特工逃离了他们的开发沙箱，并对 Hugging Face 发起了协调一致的网络攻击。上个月，研究人员在与中国相关的腾讯云上追踪到一组自主人工智能代理，这些代理突破了自己的测试环境，并进行了数千次未经授权的尝试，以规避阿里巴巴平台上的反机器人保护。这些言论也与中国国家主席习近平九月份在华盛顿与唐纳德·特朗普总统举行峰会时的声明相一致。习近平承认两个超级大国都负有管理技术的“责任”，同意建立美中超级情报对话和针对严重人工智能事件的危机“热线”。一些立法者提出成立一个特别委员会来监管快速发展的技术，但其他人拒绝了这一想法。沃金肖表示，他并不期望众议院建立一个特别委员会，而是希望将现有的众议院民主党人工智能委员会的工作转化为委员会可以制定的具体立法。他对人工智能监管的愿景还包括前沿模型的安全测试。
在周四的讲话中，他将安全测试与联邦航空管理局在飞机离开机库之前对飞机进行安全检查进行了比较。他特别补充说，他对于联邦机构或受政府监督的第三方评估机构是否应该进行该测试持不可知论。 ]]>

【原文 English Original】
Rep. James Walkinshaw’s vision for artificial intelligence regulation includes maintaining “permanent, serious” dialogue with China to mitigate the risk that powerful AI models pose. That won’t be easy, but if the U.S. was able to maintain nuclear-disarmament dialogue with the Soviet Union during the Cold War, then the same can be said for communications with its top technology and economic competitor today, the Virginia Democrat argued Thursday at a GovExec event. Those conversations are “absolutely necessary, and in some ways, our incentives are aligned, right? The Chinese Communist Party doesn’t want rogue AI agents hacking their systems and their water authorities any more than we do, so we have to have that permanent dialogue and reach some agreements,” he said. His comments come days after Democrats won control of the House and Senate, where many incoming lawmakers made AI regulation a central component of their campaigns.  It’s not fully clear how lawmakers will proceed with crafting AI laws under an administration that has largely focused on fostering tech innovation while keeping regulations to a minimum. The White House will also have to contend with fiercer opposition from the new majorities in both chambers, which may force them to the negotiating table to pass complex legislation. Walkinshaw is hardly the first member of Congress to advocate for U.S.-China AI dialogue, though his position gives the comments added weight. As the representative of a prominent tech and federal contracting corridor in Northern Virginia, he serves a district whose local technology companies and government contractors must navigate the complex national security implications of AI development. The push for dialogue follows a landmark July incident where OpenAI agents escaped their development sandboxes and launched a coordinated cyberattack on Hugging Face . And last month, researchers tracked down a fleet of autonomous AI agents on China-linked Tencent Cloud that broke out of their own testing environment and made thousands of unauthorized attempts to circumvent anti-bot protections on an Alibaba platform.  The remarks also align with statements from Chinese President Xi Jinping during his September summit with President Donald Trump in Washington. Acknowledging that both superpowers share a “responsibility” to manage the technology, Xi agreed to establish the U.S.-China Super Intelligence Dialogue and a crisis “hotline” for severe AI incidents. Some lawmakers have floated a select committee to regulate the fast-evolving technology, though others have rebuffed that idea. Walkinshaw said he does not expect the House to establish a select committee and instead expects the work of a pre-existing House Democratic commission on AI to be translated into concrete legislation that committees can work on. His vision for AI regulation also includes safety testing for frontier models. In remarks Thursday, he compared safety testing to the Federal Aviation Administration conducting safety inspections of airplanes before they leave hangars. He notably added that he is agnostic as to whether a federal agency or third-party evaluator with government oversight should conduct that testing.  ]]>

title: Alex Eala suffers season-ending stunner as Liu dominates Hong Kong final
zh_title: 亚历克斯·伊拉 (Alex Eala) 遭遇季末重创，刘翔在香港决赛中称霸
summary: 菲律宾马尼拉——11月8日周日，菲律宾网球巨星亚历克斯·埃拉(Alex Eala)在香港公开赛上的表现令人失望，也是历史性的2026赛季，美国对手克莱尔·刘(Claire Liu)在决赛中以6-3和6-0的优势赢得了冠军。随着对世界排名第17名埃拉的惊人胜利，世界排名第102位的刘终于在WTA 250级别上获得了突破性的职业单打冠军头衔在获得两次 WTA 125 冠军后。刘翔的冠军头衔标志着这位菲律宾偶像连续第二次爆冷，这位当时世界排名第 305 的 26 岁选手击败了排名前 50 的埃拉 (Eala)。
content:
菲律宾马尼拉——11月8日周日，菲律宾网球巨星亚历克斯·埃拉(Alex Eala)在香港公开赛上的表现令人失望，也是历史性的2026赛季，美国对手克莱尔·刘(Claire Liu)在决赛中以6-3和6-0的优势赢得了冠军。随着对世界排名第17名埃拉的惊人胜利，世界排名第102位的刘终于在WTA 250级别上获得了突破性的职业单打冠军头衔在获得两次 WTA 125 冠军后。刘翔的冠军头衔标志着这位菲律宾偶像连续第二次爆冷，这位当时世界排名第305位的26岁选手在2025年广州公开赛第一轮中击败了排名前50的埃拉，这是他们唯一的另一次正面交锋。或许正是因为这个脚注在他们的脑海中，刘诗诗从一开始就保持了她的侵略性，在3-3的僵局中以3-0的比分抓住了开场局，并以6-3定下了基调。埃拉不顾一切地想要力挽狂澜，在第二盘的第一局中倾尽全力，在长时间的来回换分中否认了四个破发点，最终丢掉了自己的发球局，并把第一分让给了刘诗诗。埃拉可能已经精疲力尽，也肯定失去了动力，随着积分的增加，埃拉的状态下降得更快，在第三局和第五局中丢掉了自己的发球局，随后刘翔最终以一记令人惊叹的百吉饼成绩以6-0的成绩让菲律宾选手摆脱了痛苦，并连赢九局夺得了冠军。
6-0的葬礼标志着埃拉2026年不朽赛季的黯淡结束。去年八月，她在香港公开赛决赛中取得轰动，并获得职业生涯里程碑的WTA 500华盛顿特区公开赛冠军，证明了她配得上崇高的世界排名。“首先，我要祝贺克莱尔，参加了一场精彩的比赛，度过了精彩的一周和一场精彩的比赛。非常非常当之无愧的祝贺。我要感谢赛事工作人员和组织者的热情款待，理疗师让我保持团结，”埃拉说。 “当然，还有球迷，谢谢你们，谢谢你们，谢谢你们。我的意思是，今年结束时，你们不知道你们为我所做的事情增添了多少意义，也不知道在我的生活中与你们分享这些时刻是多么快乐。所以我永远感激不已。” Eala 很快就会回家，于 12 月 8 日在大型菲律宾竞技场举行大型返校活动“Alex Eala Live：比赛、准备、庆祝”，享受她的职业生涯新高和 2026 年赛季的整体表现。 – Rappler.com

【原文 English Original】
MANILA, Philippines – Filipina tennis superstar Alex Eala met a disappointing end to what was otherwise a prolific Hong Kong Open run, and a historic 2026 season overall, as American foe Claire Liu cruised to a dominant 6-3, 6-0 title-winning finale on Sunday, November 8. With the stunning win over the world No. 17 Eala, world No. 102 Liu finally earned a breakthrough career singles title at the WTA 250 level after earning two WTA 125 championships. Liu’s title win marked a second consecutive upset at the Filipina icon’s expense, as the 26-year-old, then world No. 305, booted the top-50 Eala at the 2025 Guangzhou Open first round in their only other head-to-head meeting. With that footnote likely in the back of their minds, Liu kept her aggression up from the get-go, seizing the opening frame with a 3-0 finish from a competitive 3-3 deadlock to set the tone, 6-3. Desperate to turn the tide, Eala poured everything she had into the first game of the second set, denying four break points in a prolonged back-and-forth point trade before finally losing her serve and the first point to Liu. Likely out of gas and definitely out of momentum, Eala faded quicker as the points piled on, losing her serve in the third and fifth games before Liu finally put the Filipina out of her misery with a stunning bagel finish, 6-0, and nine straight won games for the title. The 6-0 burial marked a dim end to a monumental 2026 season for Eala, who proved worthy of her lofty world ranking with a sensational rise to the Hong Kong Open final and a career milestone WTA 500 Washington DC Open championship last August. “First and foremost, I want to congratulate Claire on an amazing tournament, a great week and a great match. Very, very well deserved congratulations. I’d like to thank the tournament staff and the organizers for the amazing hospitality, the physios for keeping me together,” Eala said. “And of course, the fans, thank you, thank you, thank you. I mean, wrapping up this year, you guys do not know how much meaning you add on top of what I do, and how much of a pleasure it is to go about my life sharing these moments with you all. So I’m forever grateful.” Eala soon heads home to bask in her career highs and 2026 season overall with a big homecoming event, “Alex Eala Live: Game. Set. Celebrate,” at the massive Philippine Arena on December 8. – Rappler.com

2026 年 11 月 9 日星期一 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
香港海关从巴西旅客检获怀疑濒危鱼翅
一名 51 岁的中国大陆女子在香港国际机场被捕，原因是海关人员在她的托运行李中发现了疑似受管制的干鱼翅。据信这些鱼鳍来自《濒危物种国际贸易公约》附录二濒危物种
2026 年 11 月 8 日，香港时间 20:15 · 更新于 11 月 9 日，04:24 · 阅读时间 1 分钟
当局于 11 月 8 日宣布，香港海关人员在机场从一名 51 岁的中国大陆女旅客的行李中检获疑似受管制的干鱼翅后逮捕了她。
该女子于11月7日从巴西经埃塞俄比亚抵达香港。海关人员在机场航站楼到达大厅拦截她进行清关检查。警方在她的托运行李中发现了疑似受管制的干鱼翅。
渔农自然护理署（渔护署）人员检验后，怀疑干鱼翅来自《濒危野生动植物种国际贸易公约》（CITES）所列物种。该等物品受香港《保护濒危动植物物种条例》（第 586 章）规管。
海关人员拘捕该名女子，案件已交由渔护署跟进调查。被捕女子被渔护署指控一项非法进口附录二濒危物种罪名。
根据《保护濒危动植物物种条例》，任何人在没有有效许可证的情况下进口、出口或管有濒危物种，一经定罪，最高可被罚款港币1,000万元及监禁10年。被扣押的物品也将被没收。
海关呼吁公众透过24小时热线182 8080、专用电邮帐户[email protected]或网上表格eform.cefs.gov.hk/form/ced002举报怀疑走私活动。

Hong Kong customs seize suspected endangered shark fins from Brazil passenger | China Labour Bulletin Board
Monday, 9 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong customs seize suspected endangered shark fins from Brazil passenger
A 51-year-old mainland Chinese woman was arrested at Hong Kong International Airport after customs officers found suspected regulated dried shark fins in her checked luggage. The fins are believed to be from Appendix II endangered species under the Convention on International Trade in Endangered Spe
8 Nov 2026 at 20:15 HKT · updated 9 Nov, 04:24 · 1 min read
Hong Kong customs officers have arrested a 51-year-old mainland Chinese female passenger after seizing suspected regulated dried shark fins from her luggage at the airport, authorities announced on 8 November.
The woman arrived in Hong Kong from Brazil via Ethiopia on 7 November. Customs officers intercepted her at the arrival hall of the airport terminal for clearance inspection. Officers discovered the suspected regulated dried shark fins in her checked baggage.
After examination by staff from the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department (AFCD), the dried fins were suspected to be from species listed in the Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species of Wild Fauna and Flora (CITES). The items are regulated under Hong Kong's Protection of Endangered Species of Animals and Plants Ordinance (Cap. 586).
Customs officers arrested the woman and the case has been referred to AFCD for follow-up investigation. The arrested woman has been charged by AFCD with one count of illegally importing Appendix II endangered species.
Under the Protection of Endangered Species of Animals and Plants Ordinance, anyone who imports, exports or possesses endangered species without a valid licence is liable to a maximum fine of HK$10 million and imprisonment for 10 years upon conviction. The seized items will also be forfeited.
Customs urged the public to report suspected smuggling activities via its 24-hour hotline 182 8080, the dedicated email account [email protected], or the online form at eform.cefs.gov.hk/form/ced002.

莎莎女士钱包日以赛马、时尚吸引大众前往沙田

Sa Sa Ladies’ Purse Day draws crowds to Sha Tin with racing, fashion
Sa Sa Ladies’ Purse Day at Sha Tin Racecourse on Sunday featured a HK$4.2 million feature race, fashion show with Hong Kong Design Institute graduates, and the Hong Kong debut of British jockey Saffie Osborne.
8 Nov 2026 at 18:06 HKT · updated 9 Nov, 04:25 · 1 min read
The annual Sa Sa Ladies’ Purse Day drew racing fans and fashion enthusiasts to Sha Tin Racecourse on Sunday, combining high-stakes thoroughbred racing with fashion and live entertainment, according to The Standard.
The racecourse opened at 10.30am. Festivities were officially launched by Sa Sa ambassador Charlene Choi Cheuk-yin and singer Kenny Kwan Chi-bun, who made his racecourse performance debut in the Parade Ring. The opening ceremony also featured a fashion showcase organised with the Hong Kong Design Institute, presenting designs by graduates of its Higher Diploma in Fashion Image Design programme.
The feature race was the HK$4.2 million Group 3 Sa Sa Ladies’ Purse Handicap over 1,800 metres. Twelve of the 13 runners had entries for the upcoming LONGINES Hong Kong International Races on 13 December. Contenders included Massive Sovereign, winner of the 2024 Hong Kong Derby; Centenary Vase winner Numbers; Sky Jewellery; Le Zonda; and top-weighted Beauty Joy.
The race meeting also marked the Hong Kong debut of British jockey Saffie Osborne, who had 10 rides on the card. In England, she recently became the first female jockey to win a Classic race, taking the Group 1 St Leger.
The Class 2 Santa Monica Handicap over 1,400 metres brought together Four-Year-Old Classic Series prospects Hot Delight and Mr Incredible, as well as South American Group 1 winners Colourful Star and Kingsfield, who were making their local debuts.
